What would you do if you felt trapped in a world of illusions and falsehoods? A young boy leaps from a high bridge, sensing the distant call of another world. Where exactly is he headed? If 23 seconds is the key, then I will press on! Even if what lies ahead is...

In a desperate bid to save the "Hashidate University High-Dimensional Engineering Laboratory" from closure, the genius—and stunningly beautiful—Professor Enri Nagisawa races across campus in search of new recruits. She soon joins forces with three eccentric girls—an "Android from Outer Space," a "Mecha-Obsessed Disciplinary Committee Member," and a "Masochistic Heiress"—and together, they transcend the bounds of reality to do whatever they please!

"Even if you're an outcast, you're never alone."

Get ready for a sci-fi Yuri comedy that’s mostly side-splittingly funny—with just a few moments that might bring a tear to your eye!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

My husband, leaving a love hotel with an unknown woman. What sort of punishment would suit the man who embraces another so intimately before his wife's very eyes...?

Did Haruto and I go to bed together!? Ayumi Shimizu is a simple office worker with a simple hobby: playing Grand Knight Fantasy on her smartphone. One day she's invited by another female player to meet up for a drink. Who should turn up, but the ace from her own company's sales department, Haruto!

212097.description:
The coming-of-age story of a kitten who finds herself in the middle of a dog clan!

Hong-Seol, a cat-human hybrid, was abandoned by her parents because she couldn’t use her inner energy. After a miserable death, she opens her eyes to find herself back at the moment just before she died.

"You are the child I’ve been searching for. Would you like to learn martial arts from me?"

With nowhere else to go, Hong-Seol is approached by the formidable “dog” shu-in clan, the Grand Patriarch of the Namgung Clan, who extends a helping hand. To survive, Hong-Seol enters the Namgung Clan.

“If they find out I’m a cat shu-in, I’ll be kicked out for sure!”

Whether they know of Hong-Seol’s daily struggle to walk on thin ice or not, these dogs come to visit her every day, wagging their tails. Except for one: the prickly eldest dog, Namgung Baek.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: A Baby Cat Who Commands the Dog Clan
The Little Kitten Who Rules the Dog Clan

212098.description:
He's always thought of her as more than a friend...

Ayaka has the worst luck with men, only dating the worst of the worst. She invites her childhood friend and coworker, Haruhiko Naruse, over for a drink to complain. Ayaka mutters to herself, wondering where the man of her dreams is. However, Haruhiko's reply is the last thing she expected him to say. She's never thought of him as more than a friend, but... A sweet story about a woman with terrible luck when it comes to men and her childhood friend, the ace of the sales department!

212099.description: Despite Mai and Yuu Shindou being fraternal twins and opposite sexes, they look very similar to each other and are surrounded by people who want them to act more like twins, such as wearing matching outfits or clinging more to each other. Amid this, Mai starts to realize that both of them are starting to change as they start going through puberty.

212100.description:
For reasons of her own, Rio enrolls in a massage academy for boys where students live in dorms. She'd planned to conceal the fact that she's a girl until the day she graduates... but it turns out she has to share her dorm room with two boys! She finds herself receiving a massage from one of them, naked! Tatsuki tells her, "I'll show you how good I am," and proceeds to touch her in a surprisingly delicate manner... as he touches her in a delicate spot, she can't help but moan. His touch just feels too good... and she can't keep quiet! Though he tells her, "You're my personal training partner," she starts to fall for him... then her other roommate starts to suspect that she's a girl...!

Chika was a plain Jane her entire schooling career. To mark her entry into college, she wants to make tons of friends and score herself a hot boyfriend!! At her college entrance ceremony, Chika gets hit on by a gorgeous guy who invites her to join his club's welcome party that night. Desperate to start her college life off on the right foot, Chika agrees, thinking it will just be a dinner. However, once there, everyone starts taking their clothes off and things heat up! Just then, Chika's upperclassman, Kaname, bursts through the door and saves her. However, Chika is upset since it was her only chance to experience intimacy for the first time. Upon hearing this, Kaname proposes something that is about to change Chika's college life for good!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

212102.description:
A pure love story between two people with a 50cm height difference and mismatched appearances and personalities.

The new part-timer is... a child!?!?

Osaki-san is tall and has a poker face, making her seem intimidating at first glance, but she's actually shy and kind. The new employee who comes to Osaki-san's workplace is Komori-san, who is only 147cm tall and very friendly.

These two, who are complete opposites in appearance and personality, find themselves drawn to each other...!? Osaki-san is clumsy and a crybaby, yet a go-getter, and Komori-san is oblivious, laid-back, and a gentle, introverted type. What will become of the love between these two, who are complete opposites and have a 50cm height difference...? This is the first installment of a hilarious and heartwarming survival-of-the-fittest (?) romantic comedy about these two quirky girls.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Note: Originally self-published on the author's Twitter, it was later acquired by Kadokawa who released the first volume on May 11, 2026.

212103.description:
Tomoe is a working adult whose relationships always fizzle out. She's 27, her parents are pressuring her to get married, and though she's reluctant, she agrees to go on a trial blind date. However, the man who shows up is her old classmate, Kyosuke, who bullied her all throughout junior high! Tomoe can't fathom marrying him, and she decides to get revenge for all the grief he caused her... by making him fall for her and then dumping him spectacularly. However, she finds herself subconsciously attracted to him, because in the time they were apart, his appearance and mannerisms have changed drastically for the better. Worried that she might fall in love with him for real, she reveals her plan... but in his anger, he forcefully brings her to climax. What will happen to Tomoe now that her body can't refuse him...!?

I want to become one with him, but I can't! -- On the night they celebrated three years since moving in together, 27-year-old office worker Kazuho had been hoping for a proposal from her boyfriend Wataru. And yet, he never raised the question of marriage... Since their relationship is sexless due to her own past trauma, she can hardly blame him. Just as she tells herself that the happy moments they spend together now are enough for her, she happens to meet a woman named Miya who has the same regional accent as Wataru. They hit it off, and Kazuho wants to introduce her new friend to Wataru, too, but for some reason he's acting strange... Ever since meeting Miya, something has gone off-kilter! Peaceful, everyday life breaks down in this story of romance and suspense.

Following the advice of her best friend, Yuzuko, and the handsome bar master, Tomoki, Fuyu tries to seduce her husband. But it ends in utter failure, leaving her depressed and confused as to what to do. Meanwhile, Takaya is struggling with his rising concern of ED, when he stumbles across a surprising sexual fetish that leaves him wanting more...

212125.description:
Sakurako is rather plain, doesn't think very highly of herself, and since she began working at her current job, she's secretly been in love with her section chief, Agatsuma. Agatsuma is good at his job, kind, and everyone loves him. Sakurako is a late bloomer and she never could quite muster up the courage to tell Agatsuma how she feels, so she settles for watching him from afar. Soon, it is all too late for her when Agatsuma is transferred to the company headquarters and out of her life.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

212129.description:
Becoming stepbrothers was supposed to be the hardest part of their parents’ romance. But when alpha Kim Yeong-Han steps in to nurse the troublesome beta Kim Min-Jae, an unexpected medical emergency shatters their lives. Min-Jae suddenly manifests as an omega, his raging heat obliterating his reason and throwing him directly into Yeong-Han’s arms. Yeong-Han tries to flee, but the thick scent of pheromones traps him instantly. Unable to resist the biology pulling them together, the two yield to temptation, leaving them with a secret that could ruin everything.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: A relationship that should never be.

212131.description:
U-Rim’s whole world used to revolve around the popular idol Ga-Ron. But after meeting Ju-Yeol in college, he fell head over heels for him so much so that he was on the verge of dropping out of school. With his good looks, sharp mind, and talent for playing in a band, Ju-Yeol is simply perfect! U-Rim, thrilled to accept his invitation to a band practice, encounters a suspicious figure loitering outside the door. But this suspicious stranger was actually my favorite idol, Ga-Ron?! Just as he found himself with Ga-Ron, U-Rim noticed an alert for Ga-Ron’s live stream. He was puzzled by the stark contrast between his dazzling appearance on the live feed and the shabby-looking Ga-Ron standing right in front of him. Ga-Ron manages to escape the crisis with a flustered excuse, but, fearing that U-Rim might expose his secret, he stubbornly insists on staying at U-Rim’s house. U-Rim grows even more suspicious of Ga-Ron’s behavior… Ga-Ron’s true identity is slowly revealed! What secret does my favorite idol on the other side of the screen have…?!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

212132.description:
Jiwoo goes fishing with her father and snags a way bigger catch than she expected. The mermaid tangled in their net is injured, so they take her home and let her stay in their bathtub until she recovers. Meanwhile, the mermaid keeps flirting with Jiwoo, who hears a rumor that any human who betrays a mermaid's love will be cursed forever. Knowing this, Jiwoo feels anxious and can't get the annoyingly charming mermaid off her back fast enough. Or at least, that's what she keeps telling herself as she sinks deeper and deeper into a dangerous ocean...

(Source: Tappytoon)

Have you ever met a “Tokujo-chan”? Whether it's during your commute to school, on the train to work, or even in the corner of a classroom, you can always count on those babes to bring a little titillating joy into your humdrum routine. From sugary-sweet glances to hot, casual touches that electrify, find out more about the world of Tokujo-chans in this collection of exquisite, full-color moments that's sure to fulfill your daily dose of joy!

(Source: Yen Press)

Hae-Young is smart, independent, a minor celebrity, and a virgin. It’s not like she hasn’t been trying—she just hasn’t found the right guy. She’s dated plenty of guys, even rising stars, but none of them have quite stacked up. After an awkward night of drinking, she discovers that her childhood friend is packing everything she wants and more. Will her bid to lose her v-card to her friend destroy their relationship, or will it lead to something more?

Ao was small and cute, someone Kaya could talk to about anything without thinking of him as a guy. Even now, with his height approaching 190cm, Ao was still Kaya's only male friend. ---Until just a moment ago.

212155.description:
Living in an internet cafe in Kabukicho and making a living as a prostitute (15,000 yen per session), Kizumi has no dreams or hopes for life and is just drifting along. However, after hearing from her fellow prostitutes that "manga artists make a good living," she begins to struggle to escape her miserable life by drawing manga, using the pillow talk of her clients and the vast collection of manga in the internet cafe as inspiration.

If I have another life, this time I want a family to love and be loved by... Odette is tasked with caring for prisoners from an enemy country. While nursing a dying man back to health, she is taken along with him by soldiers who come to rescue him, and she ends up living in the enemy nation of Krastera. The rescued man, Captain Theodore of Krastera's knights, treats Odette with respect as his savior and begins to feel something special for her. However, Odette, who has never been blessed with family or marriage, is simply doing her best to just live. This is a heartfelt, pure love story about two people with troubled pasts who find connection and hope in each other.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Hot newlyweds Mitsuri and Shizu Sato are picture-perfect both at work and at home. Everyone envies this power couple, but no one knows they have a huge problem: they still haven't consummated their marriage! Mitsuri and Shizu's battle to bed one another begins...

212159.description:
A romantic thriller exploring the dark corners of human desire and isolation with quiet eeriness.

Is a fresh start truly possible? Or will society’s strictures and your own impulses keep re-creating the same messed-up relationships in every narrow room you enter?

Choi Seongmin’s Narrow Rooms follows a young woman who leaves her rural hometown to study in Seoul and seek self-improvement. But once there, she quickly becomes the target of unwanted attention from her teacher, and the whispers of other students only deepen her alienation. Living in a cramped, poorly soundproofed room, the suffocating atmosphere begins to further distort her boundaries and perceptions. Longing for escape, she fixates on a handsome new neighbor, her fascination spiraling into obsession: She secretly rummages through his mailbox, collects his discarded cigarette butts and teabags, and hoards his trash. But when she discovers something unsavory about the object of her desire, will she be forced to confront the morals of her own behavior?

(Source: Drawn & Quarterly)

title.english: Narrow Rooms

212160.description:
You Xi is composed of fragmented “moments” or “events.” They may be easily overlooked or fleeting: a moment of reverie, a snowflake melting away, overlapping dreams, the alternating of night and day, or the waxing and waning of the moon. "Assistant Manager Kang Tae-geon, I need your body. F*ck me like crazy so I can't think of anything else."

"Tae-geon oppa."

At Hee-seo's voice, he flinched, stopped, and turned around. The sensor light poured down, casting shadows over his handsome face.

"Do you still hate me?"

(Source: Manta)

Note: Part of Metatoon's Sunjeong Danpyeonseon (순정 단편선) Collection.
synonyms: My Older Brother's Friend, Kang Taegun

title.english: My Brother's Friend TAEGEON KANG

212226.description: Kubo-kun tries to learn about romance so he can write light novels, but he's the supremely indelicate type!?
synonyms: Tactless Kubo Wants to Understand Real Love
Non-Delicacy Kubo wa Real no Koi ga Shiritai

title.native: ノンデリ久保は現実の恋が知りたい
title.romaji: Nonderi Kubo wa Real no Koi ga Shiritai

212227.description:
This story presents a harsh life drama that transcends the boundaries of a typical family drama, dealing with issues such as elderly couples caring for each other, an aging society with a declining birthrate, and young people leaving their jobs due to caregiving responsibilities. Based on the author's years of experience caring for and supporting her own parents, she fictionalizes the struggles of a father and daughter in the caregiving sphere. At some point, she finds herself caring for a father who is a typical Showa-era father—a lordly figure—all by herself. She battles against his tyranny, including his selfishness, abusive language, and unilateral actions. Utilizing the author's unique sense of humor and character portrayal, the story is sometimes humorous and at other times offers a serious reflection on family issues.

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title.native: それは嘘で、これは恋で
title.romaji: Sore wa Uso de, Koreha Koi de

212229.description: Note: Part of Haewadal Studio's Saegya Danpyeonseon (색야 단편선) Collection.
synonyms: I'm a sculptor, so why am I stripping?

212231.description: Note: Part of Metatoon's Sunjeong Danpyeonseon (순정 단편선) Collection.

title.native: 深夜、あなたのものになる
title.romaji: Shinya, Anata no Mono ni Naru

212233.description:
Badly scarred by a boat accident that claimed her parents, Yu-Wol has so far avoided the attention of the patrons who frequent the courtesan house that owns her. When a deadly incident puts her life at risk, the enigmatic Tae-Woon offers her a lifeline, but will it prove to be her salvation… or her ruin?

(Source: Manta)

title.english: Transgression

212235.description:
"Is this your first time with a woman?"

"…No… Yes… farming has just been so busy…."

Jae-I, a 5th-year editor at fashion magazine ZQ, is exhausted by Seoul and her trashy fling. On an impulsive trip to Gangwon-do, she meets Choong-Hyuk—a farmer with over 4 acres of peach orchards and celebrity-grade looks. There, she opens her eyes to true sweetness...

(Source: Manta)

Note: Part of Metatoon's Sunjeong Danpyeonseon (순정 단편선) Collection.

title.english: The Unplucked Peach Tastes The Sweetest!

title.native: 匠サマは暴きたい～輪廻に甘噛み～
title.romaji: Takumi-sama wa Abakitai: Rinne ni Amakami

212237.description:
Karina is the daughter of an earl whose estate went bankrupt, thus forcing her to work herself to the bone as a maid in the royal palace. On her way to decorate a room with flowers, Karina accidentally bumps into a dark-haired knight with piercing eyes who happens to be the so-called "earless" commander of the Wolf Knights, Hubert. Wolf ears are considered proof of a person's nobility, but Hubert hides his as they give away his emotions. This "earless" knight is famous for being cold-hearted and unmoved by any woman who approaches him. However, Karina happens to walk in on Hubert in the throes of his heat...!! Hubert confesses to Karina that his desire is to savor every inch of her. What will happen to Karina with this never-before-seen side of Hubert gazing down at her passionately!?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: The Wolf Knight's Obsessive Love -The Story Of A Wealthy Expat's Marriage-
title.native: 狼騎士様が私を好きすぎて外堀を埋めてきます!? -出稼ぎ令嬢結婚物語-
title.romaji: Ookami Kishi-sama ga Watashi wo Sukisugite Sotobori wo Umete Kimasu!?: Dekasegi Reijou Kekkon Monogatari

title.native: ひとまず猫と休みます 〜OL辞めて猫カフェ店長はじめました〜
title.romaji: Hitomazu Neko to Yasumimasu: OL Yamete Neko Café Tenchou Hajimemashita

title.native: おとなりコーディネート

212245.description:
Jude is stranded on a deserted island with an entitled family that has been treating him like their personal servant. Is this his chance to finally call the shots?

(Source: Toomics)

title.english: Master of the Island

212246.description:
You better be prepared, 'cause I'll make you feel good. After being locked in a mysterious building, I ended up performing a show. Lively music, and four gorgeous dancers... among them is an arrogant-looking guy who catches my eyes. This guy took me to a secret room, fresh after the show and starts pushing himself on me! But, just when everything was getting steamy, I turn into a woman? "Huh, this is your first time doing a 'trance', " so he says. Not knowing what's going on, I find myself in the company of these four. This series is set in the world of handsome men and those transforming into women!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: Night Cherry Blossom Trance
title.native: よざくらセックストランス

212247.description: Set in Universal Century 0123, the armed group Crossbone Vanguard, founded by Meitzer Ronah and preaching “Cosmo Aristocratism,” suddenly attacks the space colony Frontier IV, pushing it into open conflict with the Earth Federation Forces. The battle throws the colony into chaos, and Seabook Arno and his friends—caught in the middle during a school festival—struggle to reach safety as war erupts around them.

title.english: Mobile Suit Gundam Formula 91: Eternal Wind
title.native: 機動戦士ガンダムF91 エターナルウインド
title.romaji: Kidou Senshi Gundam F91: Eternal Wind

212248.description:
Five years ago, his older brother mysteriously vanished after defeating a hidden boss in the game World of the Immortal King. While the rest of the family gave up the search, he remained convinced that his brother’s disappearance is connected to the game somehow. For five years, he relentlessly challenged the same boss again and again. On his 17,860th attempt, he finally defeated the stage - and was immediately invited to cross over into the game world by a mysterious guide.

There, he learns that his only chance to bring his brother back is by completing the Immortal King’s Trial. Willing to risk everything to reach his goal, he soon discovers that the so-called trial is nothing more than a deceptive scheme - a trap from which no one has ever escaped.

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: Unrivaled in Another World by Divine Work
The Law of Hunting for the Immortal King

212250.description:
Growing up in the countryside, Hiroya hid his orientation until he moved to Tokyo. Living in the big city, he wants to finally experience life! The problem is, he's a total virgin! Unsure of himself and enlists the help of a pro! The cool and collected Take is an experienced escort ready to teach Hiroya everything he needs to know. Can Hiroya learn everything he needs to know about sex before he becomes enthralled by Take?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.english: Teach Me Dirty Things
title.native: エッチなことおしえてください

212251.description:
[Somehow, I got roped into practicing having sex with my delinquent classmate.]

"It's getting soaking wet." "I feel something... weird... stop... ah, ah!" I had no idea having sex was so embarrassing...! But Kyoya's fingertips were gentler than I imagined... Makoto is the vice president of the student council, and she's in love with its president. She wants to confess her feelings to him at the school festival when she overhears him saying he dislikes virgins and girls who are bad in bed. Makoto is crushed by his high standards. She then finds herself next to Kyoya, the lone wolf in her class, also looking despondent. Makoto wonders if Saginuma also has a crush on Takato, when Saginuma makes a startling suggestion. "I don't have any experience or a partner to have sex with... So why don't we practice together?"

(Source: CLLENN)

Note: Originally serialized under the title "Ore to Ecchi no Renshuushinee?: Furyou-kun to Naisho no XXX (俺とエッチの練習しねえ？～不良くんとナイショの×××～)".
synonyms: 俺とエッチの練習しねえ？～不良くんとナイショの×××～
Ore to Ecchi no Renshuushinee?: Furyou-kun to Naisho no XXX

title.english: Wanna Practice Having Sex with Me? ~Secret XXX with a Delinquent~
title.native: 俺と×××の練習しねえ?~不良くんとナイショの放課後~
title.romaji: Ore to XXX no Renshuushinee?: Furyou-kun to Naisho no Houkago

212252.description:
"When I started, your asshole was tight, but now it's wide open for me. Can you hear just how wet you are?"
This... is his secret sex technique...!?

Newbie but popular porn star Anzai is best at showing love. One day, he is given the chance to star in a hundred grand movie, but Tsutaya, veteran porn star, stands in his way. Unlike Anzai who focuses on emotion during his videos, Tsutaya is all about sexual technique. They are going head-to-head to fight for the right to star in this new movie by... trying to make each other fall in love? Let the sex games begin!

(Source: CLLENN)

Notes:
- Originally serialized under the title "Sex Battle Money Shot (セックスバトル・マネーショット)".
- Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: セックスバトル・マネーショット

title.english: Love Battle for the Money Shot
title.native: エッジバトル・マネーショット

212253.description:
"Keiichi's gonna stay dead" is actually a declaration of love for this newlywed-and-also-dead couple in this bonus story!

Ex-human Keiichi is as bound as ever by the overbearing love of the devil Asmodeus. The two of them go on a date to a mysterious rock called the Judgment Stone, which is said to be able to reincarnate those that wish it. However, the outing takes a chaotic turn when they meet a devil with the power to reincarnate people. And what's more, he seems to take a liking to Keiichi and tries to reincarnate him without even asking him first...!

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: Happily Ever...Dead?! (Bonus Story)
title.native: 冥婚―花嫁くんは転生前夜―【番外編】

212254.description:
Aline was betrothed to the crown prince Clovis when they were children, but they have never been close. One day, she suddenly regains memories of her past life as an ordinary office worker when she passes by the game's heroine! Originally, she was meant to be the villainess, but the heroine was always her favorite character, and now, she's determined to support her happiness instead. Aline plans to break off her engagement with Clovis, but it backfires, only making him more intrigued by her. His sweet words begin to make her falter, but will she listen to her heart?! An unpredictable love story of the former villainess, her beloved heroine, and the prince caught between them.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: You Aren't My Favorite, Your Highness...! As an Evil Princess, I've Entered a Romance Plot Where He's Fallen Head over Heels for Me?!
title.native: 推しは殿下じゃございません…！！～悪役令嬢、甘攻め溺愛ルートに突入しました！？～
title.romaji: Oshi wa Denka ja Gozaimasen...!!: Akuyaku Reijou, Ama Seme Dekiai Route ni Totsunyuu Shimashita!?

212255.description:
Jane, the daughter of an earl, is shunned by her father, brothers, and even the maids. Her only solace is the old family library. She spends her time by restoring badly damaged books. One day, Jane's aunt recommends her to work as a book restorer at Lufara Kingdom's Royal Restoration Wing. The king's younger brother, Prince Raymond, oversees the Restoration Wing. Jane had always thought that the cool, high-ranking, hard-to-approach prince was in a world far removed from her own, but thanks to a certain happening, the two get closer... A heart-swooning romance between the quiet and unassuming, yet hardworking heroine and the cool prince!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: The Book Restorer: I Restored a Legendary Grimoire, and Now the Strongest Spirit Is My Ally (For Some Reason, the Stoic Prince Is Always by My Side)
title.native: 魔導書令嬢〜伝説の魔導書を修復したら最強の精霊が味方になりました（クールな王弟殿下がなぜかいつもそばにいます）〜
title.romaji: Mashirubesho Reijo: Densetsu no Mashirubesho Oshufuku Shitara Saikyou no Seirei ga Mikata ni Narimashita (Kuruna Ototo Denka ga Nazeka Itsumo Soba ni Imasu)

212256.description:
"Mijuku na Mahoutsukai to Boku" is a precious 60-year coming-of-age story about the changing relationship between a tomboy witch master and her scarecrow familiar, me. It begins with a scene where the 6-year-old master tells me that she will teach me many things since I can't speak yet, and then the roles are reversed, with me taking care of the master, listening to her gush about her boyfriend, going to a tapioca shop with the 60-year-old master, and depicting me remaining by her side as she grows older.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: 白藤圭作品集「許嫁どのと恋のすゝめ」
title.romaji: Shirafuji Kei Sakuhinshuu "Iinazuke-dono to Koi no Susume"

212259.description:
Oscar, a powerful marquis, has spent a lifetime searching for a hidden key. Then a mysterious young woman from another continent appears holding the very thing he seeks. As he fights for closure and she resolves to stay, their frozen fates collide.

(Source: Manta)

title.english: The Cruelty of Atonement

212260.description:
Haruna is just your average office worker, trudging along on her daily grind. Haru is a K-Pop superstar chaffing against the lifestyle. One night, Haru ducks into a bar to escape a mob of sasaeng fans, only to run into Haruna... who doesn't recognize him. At all. Haruna must be the only woman in Korea who doesn't know who he is—and Haru can't get enough! But as this idol worms his way into her life, can Haruna handle the pressure of his obsession?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: The Idol Is Obsessed with Me

title.english: I'm the Idol's Obsession

synonyms: The Disappearance of a Dying Villainess

title.native: 死にかけ悪役令嬢の失踪～改心しても無駄だったので初恋の人がさらってくれました～
title.romaji: Shinikake Akuyaku Reijou no Shissou: Kaishin Shite mo Mudadatta node Hatsukoi no Hito ga Saratte Kuremashita

title.native: 死にかけ悪役令嬢の失踪 改心しても無駄だったので初恋の人がさらってくれました
title.romaji: Shinikake Akuyaku Reijou no Shissou Kaishin Shite mo Mudadatta node Hatsukoi no Hito ga Saratte Kuremashita

title.native: COMPANYースターダムな仲間たちー

212269.description: Teranishi and Ejji go to a reunion at their old junior high school, with the main event being the unearthing of a time capsule buried twenty years ago. It contains all sorts of photographs and memories, including letters that the kids had written to each other. Teranishi recalls writing a letter to Kumi Shinoda, a girl whom the class despised because she was a relentless bully who complained about everything.

title.english: Under the Soil

synonyms: The Turtle Can't Pass by the Sleeping Hare!
The Turtle Cannot Pass the Sleeping Rabbit!

title.native: 거북이는 잠자는 토끼를 지나칠 수 없어!
title.romaji: Geobugineun Jamjaneun Tokkireul Jinachil Su Eopseo!

212271.description:
Sang Lee is a courier who makes deliveries for a beatdown. But when Seonha puts in an order of her own, his life takes an abrupt turn. Taking the wheel with her in shotgun, he dives into a world filled with political heavyweights, corrupt businessmen, and backdoor meetings in the underworld where power and strength mean everything. Sang knows this will be a bloody ride, but can he come out of it alive?

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: ส่งด่วนหมัดเดือด

title.english: Fight Delivery

212274.description:
Ui fell head over heels for art teacher Yugahara at his high school orientation. No matter how many times he proclaims his love, Yugahara keeps finding reasons to turn him down, saying that they're both guys and that they’re teacher and student.

“I graduate in six months, so please wait for me until then.”

Determined to make his teacher look his way, Ui keeps up with his relentless pursuit today and everyday! An absolute 120% pure high school romance that will have you rooting for the lovestruck boy!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 雨が降ったら、君とキスを
title.romaji: Ame ga Futtara, Kimi to Kiss wo

212276.description:
After a facial scar leaves her shunned and withdrawn, Mishiro's only comfort is painting. Everything changes when she meets Kuroe, an upperclassman with her own quiet sorrows, and the two begin to find their way toward each other through the art of blackboard murals.

(Source: BluPetal)

title.english: The Black World is Dyed in White Chalk
title.native: 黒の世界は白墨に染まる
title.romaji: Kuro no Sekai wa Hakuboku ni Somaru

title.native: 女にはそれぞれ裏がある
title.romaji: Hito ni wa Sorezore Ura ga Aru

synonyms: My Lovely Daughter and Her Girlfriend Are Such a Cute Couple

title.native: 娘が彼女を連れてきた話
title.romaji: Musume ga Kanojo wo Tsuretekita Hanashi

212279.description:
Which one is the true masochist?? A perverted girl comedy about two high school girls!!

Shizuka Muraizumi and Junrei Maihama, first-year high school students, are girls who look like each other. However, Shizuka, who aspires to be a novelist, and Junrei, who dreams of becoming a manga artist, are true masochists who fantasize about the other person as their ideal queen. Because of this, even though they seem to be in love with each other, they rebel against each other at important points. In order to be able to accept and interact with each other, the two decide to conduct various experiments, but they escalate in an outrageous direction...!?

(Source: Bunkasha, translated)

212281.description: An invitation to “Shironagasu Island” found in a billionaire’s will. Ikeda Sen, a private detective based in New York, sets off for the island alongside Nenekko Izumizaki, a girl with special abilities. A series of bizarre murders unfolds there. What is the truth hidden on Shiroganasu Island...?

title.native: シロナガス島への帰還

212282.description:
Kunika, the student council president who believes herself to be a "cool beauty," continues to cause trouble and surprise to her childhood friend and caring vice president, Kinako!!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title.native: ばってん今！！生きとっと
グレート・ジャーニー

212287.description:
After discovering she has the powers of a saintess at the age of five, Estelle is forced to work day in and day out for much of her life. Fearing she'll be worked even harder if her true powers are revealed, she decides to hide just how powerful she really is. As long as she can eat every day and have a roof over her head, she even decides to put up with the snot-nosed crown prince of the country and gets engaged to him. Just when she believes her days of struggling to survive had ended, a girl from another world arrives and catches the prince's eye! He breaks off their engagement and brands her a "false saintess," ordering her execution. Fed up with all the idiocy, she unleashes her full power and puts the prince and his followers in their place. Finally free, where will she go with this newfound freedom...?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: The Saintess Came From Another World, so I Was Kicked to the Curb: Since I'm Going to Be Executed, I'll Unleash My Hidden Power!
title.native: 異界から聖女が来たのでお役御免になりました～処刑されそうなので隠した力を解放させていただきます！～
title.romaji: Ikai kara Seijo ga Kitanode Oyaku Gomen ni Narimashita: Shokei Saresou nanode Kakushita Chikara wo Kaihou Sasete Itadakimasu!

212288.description:
Ayaha Yamanouchi has been living out busy days working in the General Affairs department of a large company... but one day something changed. Her underwear went missing. Things start to feel uneasy as she begins to think there is someone out there stealing underwear. The following day, she's met with the police questioning individuals about a slasher on the loose... what better a time to make a report about what's been happening recently? Suddenly, a charming young officer shows up as the report is made... it turns out the elite police deputy is her childhood friend, Kaito Shirasaki?!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: Reunited With My Childhood Friend Who Became a Mischievous Elite Police Deputy and Now We're Living Together!
title.native: 再会した幼なじみは悪戯なエリート警視～初心な同居がスタートしました～
title.romaji: Saikai Shita Osananajimi wa Itazura na Elite Keishi: Ubu na Doukyo ga Start Shimashita

212291.description:
Every 10,000 years, a Heavenly Demon--a legendary master of the Demonic Cult--is born. But the modern era has two geniuses: Hoya, a boy with a burning interest in martial arts but no inner power, and Soma, the disciple of the Mad Demon who wiped out the Murim Alliance in a single day. When fate brings them together, Hoya decides to learn everything he can from Soma, but Soma only wants Hoya’s help in figuring out the password to his master’s well-stocked bank account. Who will claim the title of Heavenly Demon, and will they remain friends or become rivals?

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: Mu Mu Mu

212292.description:
Please teach me... with that wonderful body of yours! - Hotori, an office worker, starts to go to the gym to get some exercise on the advice of her co-worker. Being completely new, and having no clue what to do, she tries to use a familiar-looking machine, only to lose control of it and nearly collapse! But instead of hitting the ground, she finds herself embraced by an attractive muscular man! Spellbound by his gentle demeanor and incredible body, Hotori leaves without asking his name. Thus, she sets out to find him again, but... I want to meet you again, and learn more and more about this strange feeling that makes my heart tremble!

(Source: CLLENN)

title.english: I Want Kumagaya to Teach Me Everything
title.native: ぜんぶ、熊ケ谷さんに教えてほしい

212293.description:
Despite being unemployed, Tsuguko spends all her money on her boyfriend, Ryoga. She convinces herself that this is an investment in him and their future... but Ryoga turns out to be an escort and leaves her with $50k's worth of debt! Gangster Domeki kicks her door in and tells her he'll have her work in his bathhouse to pay off her debt. But, before that, he decides to give her a test spin! Will Tsuguko be able to dig herself out of the hole she's found herself in!?

(Source: CLLENN)

title.english: Working Off Her Debt -How Tsuguko Fell For Her Debt Collector!-
title.native: 極道の俺をなめるなよ？ ～淫らでエッチな腰使い、何回イッても離してくれない！～
title.romaji: Gokudou no Ore wo Nameru na yo?: Midara de Ecchi na Koshi Tsukai, Nankai Itte mo Hanashite Kurenai!

212294.description:
An ordinary guy becomes SSS rank with his daughter's enhancement magic!? One day, retired adventurer Wolf is entrusted with a mysterious baby, Reminia. Growing up as a daddy's girl, she earns the title of "Great Hero" and begins serving in the royal palace. Worried about her father who lives far away, Reminia secretly enhances her physical defense, magic defense, agility, and automatic recovery to the maximum level—a story of a retired adventurer's rise to power that will make his blood boil!

(Source: Comic Meteor, translated)

title.native: アラフォー冒険者、伝説となる ~SSランクの娘に強化されたらSSSランクになりました~
title.romaji: Arafou Boukensha, Densetsu to Naru: SS-Rank no Musume ni Kyouka Saretara SSS-Rank ni Narimashita

212295.description:
Dungeons suddenly appeared in the world. Humanity built a new society using items found in the dungeons and materials obtained from monsters.

Haruhiko Ito, a company employee, grew tired of his busy daily life and decided to become an "explorer" to make a living by exploring dungeons. He first used several skill orbs that could grant special abilities, but they were all duds. He thought the last orb would also be a dud... but what he obtained was the strongest skill, "Magic," which allows him to acquire vast knowledge of magic! Will the former salaryman explorer become a savior with the strongest skill!?

(Source: Comic Corona, translated)

Note: Chapters 11-30 were split into two parts during the original serialization.

title.native: 中年魔術師の悠々自適なダンジョン攻略～スキルオーブを使ったら最強スキルを手に入れたので、好きに生きようと思います～@COMIC
title.romaji: Chuunen Majutsushi no Yuuyuujiteki na Dungeon Kouryaku: Skill Orb wo Tsukattara Saikyou Skill wo Te ni Ireta node, Suki ni Ikiyou to Omoimasu @COMIC

212296.description:
"You just need to feel good." I used to live a life with no restrictions as the daughter of the company president. When I lost both of my parents, my fiancé, Souta, left me. We were engaged, but without the company, he had no more use for me. Despite that, his brother, Iori, took me in. He hated his brother and apparently wanted to get revenge by making me happy. I accepted his proposal and signed a marriage contract with him. Even though I didn't expect them, he bought me clothes, went on dates, and introduced me to people in his company. I couldn't help but feel very happy. I know he says that by being happy will get our revenge, but Iori has provided me such a luxurious life. When we have sex, he's so gentle since I'm still not used to it. He uses his fingers and tongue to make me feel all sorts of pleasure. I'm happy, but is it really okay for me to continue like this...!?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: An Engagement without Dating with My Scion Childhood Friend: A Lovey-Dovey Life Even with a Contract Marriage!?
title.native: 幼馴染の御曹司と交際ゼロ日婚～契約婚なのに溺愛トロトロ生活!?～
title.romaji: Osananajimi no Onzoushi to Kousai Zero-nichi Kon: Keiyaku-kon nanoni Dekiai Torotoro Seikatsu!?

212297.description:
This is a sweet, heartwarming romance between a young high school couple: Yukari Mishima, the school's idol, and Yamato Onodera, a boy who tends to fly under the radar. It is a relationship you can’t help but want to root for.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: 平凡でありふれた、幸せな恋愛。
title.romaji: Heibon de Arifureta, Shiawase na Renai.

212298.description:
Shin Jia steps into the clinic for a routine checkup, only to find herself trapped in a world of pure indulgence. Under the quiet dim of the examination room, medical procedure turns into an irresistible game of temptation. Surrounded by striking physicians who refuse to keep their hands to themselves, Jia burns with shame as their gloved touches explore her most sensitive spots. Leading the pack is Dr. Doh Minjun, whose cool professionalism hides a devious urge to push her boundaries. What was meant to be a simple exam quickly devolves into a seductive ordeal she cannot resist.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: I Just Went For A Health Checkup

title.english: Doctor's Orders

212299.description:
"I want you to know just how much I love you."

I'm a 27-year-old office lady working at an ad agency. I haven't had a boyfriend in ages? Until Kiyoshi, who everyone at the office says is the perfect guy, suddenly asked me out.

The very first time we had dinner together, he told me he liked me, and the next thing I knew we were at his place. He was as much a gentleman in bed as he was at dinner, kissing me from head to toe and even making me come.

To top it all off, he held me until morning, when we decided to make things official. I couldn't believe my luck! Somehow, he even knew all about what I like, all about my life... Could this be fate? Or something else?!

I had fallen head over heels for the perfect guy, and he turned out to be a stalker... Meet my creepy, overbearing, scary, loving, dreamy boyfriend!!

(Source: CLLENN)

title.english: My Dreamy Boyfriend is an Obsessed Stalker!? An Office Worker Trapped in Pleasure
title.native: スパダリ社内彼氏は溺愛ストーカー!?～27歳OL、極上の快感から逃れられない～
title.romaji: Super Darling Shanai Kareshi wa Dekiai Stalker!?: 27-sai OL, Gokujou no Kaikan kara Nogarerarenai

212300.description:
On her first day at her job at the bank, Yumeha Ayase is reunited with her childhood friend and middle-school punk ex-boyfriend, Ko Ogami. Ko is still just as intimidating as ever, but Yumeha finds herself attracted to him once again as he helps keep her after getting drunk during a welcome dinner party.

When she excuses herself to go to the bathroom and freshen up, a worried Ko, thinking Yumeha's taking too long, goes in to check on her and bumps right into her. Yumeha drops her pouch, spilling out all of her naughty toys inside! Ko then invites her back to his place, where Yumeha expects things to take a steamy turn, but she just ends up getting lectured by Ko instead!

Frustrated, Yumeha mounts Ko, tells him she's always loved him, and rips her shirt off, taking Ko's hand and planting it on her chest! How will Ko react!? Don't miss this spicy love story between a sultry bank employee and her intimidating ex-bad boy boss!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: My Secret Sex Drive... Yearnings for My Badass Boss!
title.native: 実は性欲スゴイんです…元ヤン上司が好きで、欲しくて、食べたい。
title.romaji: Jitsu wa Seiyoku Sugoin desu... Motoyan Joushi ga Suki de, Hoshikute, Tabetai.

212301.description: Note: Published on author's Pixiv Fanbox account

title.native: い〇うと孕ませないとレベルアップできない異世界転生
title.romaji: Imouto Haramasenai to Level Up Dekinai Isekai Tensei

212302.description: Note: Part of Metatoon's Sunae Danpyeonseon (순애 단편선) Collection.
synonyms: The Fox Borrowing the Tiger's Might

212304.description: Note: Originally self-published on the author's Postype. Was published by Ridibooks on 2026-05-09.

212305.description: Note: Originally self-published on the author's Aladin account. Was published by Ridibooks on 2026-05-09.

212306.description:
Tae-Rim, a high school student on the cusp of adulthood, is pondering her future. She laments that she has led such an ordinary life and fears she is destined for a mundane, uneventful existence. Tae-Rim has a friend named Seon-Ho who seems somehow special and mysterious. Seon-Ho, who appears to be good at everything, is kind but difficult to get close to. When Tae-Rim accidentally discovers Seon-Ho’s secret, she becomes entangled in his family history. As she works to resolve the situation, she reflects on and experiences friendship, career choices, family, and love, and in the process, she grows as a person.

(Source: Naver Series, translated)

212307.description:
After her parents' death, Lady Vanessa is left with only two things—a mountain of debt and a marriage. Her greedy uncle is all too willing to sell her off as a fresh bride to an aging earl. To escape this arranged fate, she needs a scandal. A truly horrible, ruinous scandal.

(Source: Manta)

title.english: Garden of May

212310.description:
I swear that I'll always treat you right. Thanks to his teasing fingers and deft tongue, she feels like she's about to lose her mind to the inescapable pleasure of his touch...! Shino Ito is a nerdy office worker who's obsessed with her favorite character, the cool and aloof Vice-Commander Kai. Luckily for her, her boss Katsuya Okuno (who she's lovingly dubbed "Vice-Commander") looks exactly like him. One night, after getting stood up by a friend, Shino finds herself drinking at a bar with Katsuya, whose kind advice just might be making her heart flutter more than usual. By the time Katsuya helps a drunk Shino home, she mistakes him for Vice-Commander Kai... and dreams that they're having sex! But the mind-numbingly sweet kisses and rock-hard sensations in her dream feel a bit too real... "You're the one who seduced me, so you better be prepared." Could it be possible that it wasn't Vice-Commander Kai in her dream, but her boss?! And it wasn't a dream, but reality?! As Shino struggles to make sense of the situation she finds herself in, Katsuya makes his move... but there's something else he's not telling her...

(Source: CLLENN)

title.english: The Nerd and Her Fantastical Boss: Oath to Treat You Right
title.native: オタク女子×こじらせ上司～抱く前から大切にするって決めてました～
title.romaji: Otaku Joshi × Kojirase Joushi: Daku Mae kara Taisetsu ni surutte Kimetemashita

212311.description:
Anzu Konagai is a designer whose plain fashion sense and meek personality belie a burning passion for cosmetics. One day, she is reunited with her childhood friend, Yu, who has become a successful and famous makeup artist overseas. She chalks up his excessive hugging to the simple joy of meeting an old friend. As soon as they're alone, however, he reveals deeper, stronger desires. Just as makeup can transform a woman's looks, Yu is about to give Anzu's whole life a big makeover...

(Source: CLLENN)

title.english: His Lips Melt My Heart -The Charismatic Cosmetic Casanova-
title.native: 重ねて、濡らして、トロける唇～カリスマ男子の淫らなメイク術～
title.romaji: Kasanete, Nurashite, Torokeru Kuchibiru: Karisuma Danshi no Midara na Meiku-jutsu

212312.description:
Nanako's first love was the handsome and kind boy next door, Kazu, but he moved away to college. Now that she's all grown up and they're practically neighbors again, will she finally get him to notice her? He's still the perfect gentleman he always was and gets her heart racing... that is until he asks Nanako to wear a certain pair of ears that has his friendly demeanor doing a 180! In a fit of excitement, he pounces on her and proclaims his love for her... his sweet words mask his fierce passion in bed. It looks like getting Kazu to notice Nanako is going to be easier than she thought, but not in the way she expected. Once she finds out his kink, he only has eyes for her. Who knew trying on some cat ears was all it would take to win her first love's heart... and ignite his desire? She's never even kissed a boy before, but she's willing to go all the way.

(Source: CLLENN)

title.english: Does This Outfit Turn You On? -My Doting Boyfriend's Wild Obsession-
title.native: エッチな格好で興奮するね？～溺愛カレシのヤバい性癖～
title.romaji: Ecchi na Kakkou de Koufun suru ne?: Dekiai Kareshi no Yabai Seiheki

212313.description:
It's January 2019, and the calendar is about to change to the Reiwa era. Gump, a cynical manga artist nearing forty, is enjoying his first-ever reprint of a book. However, his life takes a sudden turn. The doctor tells him... "colon cancer"!? While his wife is grieving, Gump initially finds it hard to believe, but as the days go by, he gradually begins to record his rising emotions as "daily journals"—this is the rambling "battle against cancer" of a cynical manga artist nearing forty.

(Source: Sunday Webry, translated)

212314.description:
A strong arm catches Nanako just before she falls, followed by a passionate kiss. "No, I can't reject such..." Nanako is utterly in love with her boyfriend, Kotetsu?the charismatic and brilliant CEO. As she anticipates the proposal, her dream turns into a nightmare by getting kidnapped. Kotetsu arrives in a desperate, last-minute rescue, but he takes a blade to the back. The small space of the cut reveals a terrifying secret: a tattoo of a tiger. "I'm actually a yakuza." The true story of a dedicated yakuza's unexpected, all-consuming love

(Source: CLLENN)

title.english: The Tiger of Yakuza: Fills His First Love to the Brim
title.native: 極道の虎～初愛ヤクザは私のナカまで愛を注いで離さない～
title.romaji: Gokudou no Tora: Hatsuai Yakuza wa Watashi no Naka made Ai wo Sosoide Hanasanai

212315.description: Konishi, Kawaguchi and Takashio are three old friends from university. When a passenger plane carrying Takashio loses signal en route, Konishi insists on going out to search, against the advice of his sister and Kawaguchi.

title.english: Near Miss!

212316.description:
"I wanted you to keep touching me like this." But the only time he can touch his late childhood friend is in the dead of night.

Itsuki, Sota's first love, has died. Unable to even tell him how he felt, Sota spends his days consumed by lingering attachment and regret, sometimes even thinking, "Maybe I'd rather be cursed by him instead." Perhaps that twisted wish was answered, because one night, Itsuki appears before him as a ghost. But something about the way he looks is strange. Could it be that Sota's own ugly desire has turned him into a vengeful spirit? And yet, when the boy he had always longed to touch appears right in front of him, Sota can no longer keep his thoughts under control...

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: Your Body's Still Warm
title.native: 君の死体はあたたかい

212317.description:
"I'll move in a bit... Just a bit longer..." is the spark that kicks off an interspecies relationship between a lazy lion and an overly-altruistic human guarding his heart in this cute-yet-erotic romantic comedy!

In this world, "animacodes", a species with both human and animal characteristics, coexist alongside humans. Ryusei, who works in a facility that takes care of animacodes, has long admired lions for how cool they are, but his idealized image crumbles when he is tasked with caring for Raul, a loafing lion animacode. Although exasperated, Ryusei looks after Raul, but... he had no idea lions were packing! Ohhh, shiiit!

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: No One Told Me the King of Beasts Was Such a Slacker!
title.native: 百獣の王がヒモだなんて聞いてない！
title.romaji: Hyakujuu no Ou ga Himo da nante Kiitenai!

212318.description:
"I'll love you until the day I die," is the confession that pierces his heart. "If you say something like that, I can't help but to fall in love with you!!"
A school rom-com BL starring an introvert who refuses to show his eyes and an outgoing boy who's into gyaru fashion!

Lately, there's someone who's caught the attention of social butterfly Hinata. That person is no other than Yuki, his gloomy classmate who hides his eyes behind overgrown bangs. "I have to get a glimpse of his eyes!" With that goal in mind, Hinata begins to close the distance between them. After a few months, and the two firm friends, Hinata takes a look beneath those bangs... only to find out that Yuki is a stud?! Stunned by his friend's face and heart beating fast, Hinata impulsively says, "Should I let myself be swept away?"

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: Hinata: Cute, Sincere, and Very Gyaru
title.native: ちょろかわギャルの陽大くん
title.romaji: Choro ka wa Gal no Hinata-kun

212320.description:
"You're not being sexy about it at all. Let me show you."
Hearts are sure to pound as mutual love is realized in this BL about a "mom-type" protagonist and the cool, stoic guy who's won his heart.

Childhood friends Fuyuki and Haruka have decided to live together upon starting college, and Haruka gets to be the only one to see a flawed side of the otherwise perfect Fuyuki. Haruka acts like he doesn't enjoy taking care of Fuyuki, but he secretly loves to spoil his crush. However, he overhears a group of guys at school talking about how childhood friends always end up as losing heroines in romance stories! Will Haruka never end up with the guy of his dreams...? That night, he gets overexcited and pushes Fuyuki down onto the bed "as a prank"... "I want to get to first base with Fuyuki, and then maybe even score a home run," he eagerly resolves to himself. Haruka wants to escape being the guy version of a losing (male) heroine and become Fuyuki's boyfriend if it's the last thing he does!

(Source: Coolmic)

title.native: 春楓くんは負けヒロインにはならない！
title.romaji: Haruka-kun wa Make Heroine ni wa Naranai!

212321.description:
"I'm not gonna be satisfied with one lousy kiss like that."
A clumsy, innocent college student and his playful, popular friend collide in this chaotic BL romance!

Riku is a college student who's desperate to get a girlfriend, but every time he confesses his feelings, he gets rejected. Right after his thirteenth rejection, his best friend, Minato, manages to get under his skin with his unnecessary teasing. Furious, Riku storms off and somehow ends up at a mysterious shrine that can show people their future. "Show me a happy future with a cute girl by my side!" he cautiously requests. However, much to his surprise, he sees himself kissing... Minato?! No way! If that's his future, then he'll change it himself! Riku struggles to rewrite his fate, but waiting for him is something way more intense than just a kiss!

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: Destined to Kiss My Best Friend
title.native: おれは親友とキスする運命らしい
title.romaji: Ore wa Shinyuu to Kiss Suru Unmeirashii

212324.description:
I'm your hostage, so you can have your way with me.
A stubborn older king and a devoted noble prince navigate their love in this fantasy BL!

Prince Lim has offered himself as a hostage to the palace of the neighboring kingdom of Suyarvilette, all so he can meet his first love, Finn, the man who was once in charge of his education. No matter what Lim does, he can't shake the complicated feelings he has for the man who took such good care of him as a child. Lim tries to close the distance between them using his status as a hostage as an excuse, but Finn refuses to budge and begins making preparations to send Lim home. Lim can't stand to be away from his beloved, and, in an attempt to get Finn's blood pumping and seduce him, invites him by saying, "I'm an adult now"...

(Source: Coolmic)
synonyms: Lock Me Up, I Promise to Behave.

title.english: I'll Be a Good Boy, so Lock Me up Tight
title.native: いい子にするから閉じ込めて
title.romaji: Ii Ko ni Suru kara Tojikomete

212325.description:
I refuse to believe that the reason I can't have sex is because of a psychic phenomenon...!

Satsuki is about to turn 30 without going all the way with another guy, and he's beginning to get worried. Every time he gets close, a series of unfortunate events always puts a stop to his fun. One evening, while drinking at his regular bar, a fortune teller warns him that he has a guardian spirit haunting his butt! Of course, that sounds way too ridiculous to be true, so Satsuki decides to use a toy to take matters into his own hands. But before he can, a hot guy suddenly appears out of thin air and proclaims, "I won't let you give your butt to anyone else!"

An innocent but hot butt guardian spirit and a beautiful guy who wants to lose his anal virginity duke it out in this BL romcom!

(Source: Coolmic)
synonyms: The Story of My Possessed Butt

title.english: Me and the Ghost Haunting My Butt
title.native: 俺の尻が憑かれてる話
title.romaji: Ore no Shiri ga Tsukareteru Hanashi

212326.description:
"You're gonna marry me," an arrogant top declares to a loner streamer bottom. Their thrilling, dangerously sweet streaming romance begins!

Chiharu is a college student who also works as a streamer doing adult content. However, at school, he keeps such a low profile that he barely seems to exist and spends his days alone. One day, Kaisei, the popular guy in his class, confronts him, saying that he knows about Chiharu's streams. Chiharu worries that Kaisei is going to expose his secret to the entire school, but instead, Kaisei angrily shouts, "You made me malfunction down there!" He corners Chiharu, insisting, "I'm gonna prove there's no way I'd get hard over some loser like you." Chiharu is then pushed into showing himself off in front of Kaisei, even more explicitly than he ever has on stream!

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: Chiharu's Failed Livestream
title.native: 千晴くんのしくじり配信

synonyms: The wolf prince and his white bride.

title.native: 狼王弟と白のお嫁さん
title.romaji: Ookami Outei to Shiro no Oyome-san

title.native: だしちゃいましょう先輩！
実況禁止のアフターナイト

212330.description:
Naoya Kagenishi, a gloomy college student, is secretly in love with Haruta Kasugai, an outgoing, handsome guy from his workplace, and masturbates every day thinking about him. Obviously, he was content with fantasizing about him, so he didn't expect Haruta himself to invite him to drink at home together...! Is going to the house of your crush the same as visiting a holy site!? Overwhelmed with nervousness, he mustered up the courage to go, only to end up too drunk to think clearly anymore! In his drunkenness, he accidentally confessed that he masturbates thinking about him before he realized!! "Wanna go further than your fantasies with the real me?" Caressed mercilessly by his hands and his tongue all over his body, he loses his reasoning from the pleasure, and his true feelings go out of control. Could this be the beginning of a real love story, not just a fantasy...!?

(Source: Mobile Media Research)

title.english: Excessive Love from the Adorable Kagenishi
title.native: かわいい陰西くんとの拗らせ愛

212331.description:
It's Kohane's 29th birthday. She's been living with her younger boyfriend, whom she's been dating since her student days, for six years. She's excited, wondering if he might propose. But they haven't had sex in a long time. She heads home with a faint glimmer of hope. But instead of a proposal, he brings a ridiculous suggestion...!? "How about we enjoy being single for about two years before getting married?" Kohane is pressured into accepting two years of infidelity...

(Source: DPN Books, translated)

title.native: サムシングフォーブルー～わたしのしあわせは結婚？～
title.romaji: Something for Blue: Watashi no Shiwase wa Kekkon?

212332.description:
An ordinary female college student who was job hunting gets reincarnated as a Duke's daughter! Her Prince fiancé becomes a beast at night and is cursed to "eat" maidens' virginity?!

(Source: Daitosha)

title.english: The Reborn Beauty and the Beastly Prince
title.native: 転生美女と夜が野獣王子
title.romaji: Tensei Bijo to Yoru ga Yajuu Ouji

212333.description:
Kim Gye-Ran, a passionate teacher who believes exercise is the cure-all, becomes the homeroom teacher for Class 3 of the third year at Muscle High School. Is there a student with problems? How about we go for a run first?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title.native: 午前2時のハートフィズ

212335.description: The "Xenogears Comic Anthology" is a collection of short stories that take place throughout the present and future of the Xenogears timeline. Most are comical, but there are a few serious character pieces.

title.native: Xenogearsコミックアンソロジー

212337.description:
Goemon, a notorious thief who's been causing a stir in town, clashes with the Whiskers, a gang of villains, over the treasure held by a young boy named Bao. Just when he's cornered and desperate, Goemon's second personality awakens — unleashing instinctive kung fu attacks that take down his enemies... What awaits Goemon and Bao on their goofy adventure?! A nonstop action comedy begins!

(Source: Anime News Network)

212338.description: Note: Won 2nd place in Kadokawa's Wordless World Manga Contest 2025

title.native: わたしのかわいいおんなのこ

synonyms: You Are at the End of the Downfall

212342.description:
A classmate who is a super tiny fairy...? Daimonji, the "Fairy Caretaker," is drawn to the cuteness of fairy high schooler Pikushima, but one day he comes face to face with her loneliness...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.english: The Fairy Next to Me

212343.description:
The day the internet vanished from the world, a smartphone-addicted girl encountered an alien collecting nutria.

(Source: Harta, translated)

Note: Published in Harta vol.120

212344.description:
A long-haired man walks on, preaching the importance of traffic rules to every passerby he meets. "I can’t afford to stop," he declares. But what is the reason behind his relentless journey?

(Source: Harta, translated)

Note: Published in Harta vol.120
synonyms: How to Walk on the Sidewalk

212345.description:
Zhang Yuan ascends through cultivation, only to arrive in a bizarre and terrifying world. Above the nine heavens lurk horrifying immortal Buddhas and gods, while mortals below are raised like livestock… Strange and deadly “anomalies” infest the land, and cultivators who are neither fully human nor ghost cling desperately to survival… Can this world still have a future? Zhang Yuan doesn’t care. All he wants is to ascend once more and return to the Immortal Realm. But… can he truly go back?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.native: 君の腕の中で息を吐く
title.romaji: Kimi no Ude no de Iki wo Haku

title.native: 期限切れフレンドシップ

synonyms: More Than a Boyfriend, Less Than a Super Daring

title.native: スパダリ未満、彼氏以上。
俺の彼氏がユーレイになりまして
title.romaji: Ore no Kareshi ga Yurei ni Narimashite

title.native: ぼっちゃんに永久就職希望です
title.romaji: Bocchan ni Eikyuu Shuushoku Kibou desu

212356.description:
A delicately woven tale of human nature that speaks to the need for interpersonal connection and the bravery it takes to escape the inertia and safety of our existence and go beyond the boundaries that confine us.

Note: Released at COMITIA 115.

212357.description:
Two high school girls living in a town suddenly hit by a typhoon...

Every day, on her way home from club activities, she begins to be attacked by a mysterious creature. Moreover, for some reason, only seniors are targeted. However, every time, the senior returns safely. As if possessed by something.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

212359.description:
Cover Illustration: Eru Kudou
1. Koori no Reijou wa Yoru ni Tokeru (氷の令嬢は夜に溶ける) [Eru Kudou]
2. Koushou wa Goshinchou ni (交渉はご慎重に) [Kuro Itsuki]
3. Akuma demo Anata no Mono (アクマでもアナタのモノ♡) [Chiyaho]
