5. Haru wo Matsu Niwa de (春を待つ庭で) [Akirannu]
6. Ame ga Kureta Mono (雨がくれたもの) [Korone Neko]
7. Unbalance (アンバランス) [Hibiki Aoto]
212359.hashtag: #絶対に主従が逆転する百合えっちアンソロジー
synonyms: Turn the Tables Yuri H Anthology

title.native: 絶対に主従が逆転する百合えっちアンソロジー
title.romaji: Zettai ni Shujuu ga Gyakuten Suru Yuri Ecchi Anthology

212362.description:
“I wanted you, and it’s not like I actually dislike you, but I can’t stand being treated this way.”

Min Jeong-Ha was adopted as the youngest son of a shamanic family that has been sought out by political and business tycoons for generations. Having grown up as the sole recipient of the attention and affection of his older brother, Min Ji-Han, who is three years his senior and possesses both a steady, gentle disposition and business acumen. Jeong-Ha suddenly becomes a thorn in the family’s side the moment he enters college. Behind Jeong-Ha’s sudden change lies the truth he has just discovered: he was adopted to serve as a scapegoat for the Min family… Filled with rage at the betrayal of being used by the very people he believed were his family, Jeong-Ha pushes Ji-Han away. Faced with Jeong-Ha’s sudden change in attitude, Ji-Han tries to force him to comply and attempts to get rid of the “problem” to win him back… But in trying to escape his brother’s disastrous obsession, has he instead brought upon himself an even worse disaster?!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

212363.description:
Baekri Cheongra, the top disciple of the Howol Sect. Renowned throughout the martial arts world for his achievements far surpassing those of her peers his elegant and beautiful appearance, and his righteous character, he harbored a strange and secretive desire that would surely draw scorn from others if they were to find out. That desire was the longing to be completely subjugated by someone. Then, Dang Ran-Yeong of the Sacheon Clan appeared before Cheongra. Though he was notorious throughout the martial arts world for his vicious and ruthless deeds, Cheong-Ra’s heart began to stir at his imposing presence, sculpted features, and formidable martial prowess...

“Young Master Baek-Ri, I never would have guessed that someone with such a refined face and noble demeanor would be such a pervert.”

“Young Master Dang, I want you to… treat me despicably.”

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
synonyms: Moonlit Night, Moonlit Sleep, Moonlit Cup

212364.description:
Nam Min-Seong, who lives by the motto “Men are gold,” gets hit with a Frappuccino during his first meeting with Geon-Hyeok, whom he met on a dating app, and is then told to leave by Geon-Hyeok, an executive, while out with his running crew. Confused and humiliated, Min-Seong starts to get angry...

"He said he liked me on the app, so why is this jerk treating me like this?"

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

212365.description:
In my past life, I was so ugly I was nicknamed "piggy-gorilla," but I have now been reborn in a future where Japan resembles the Heian period... as Kaguya, a one-in-a-thousand-years beauty. Running away when my brother was about to assault me, I was saved by Yasuhito, a gorgeous man similar to the one I loved in my past life. We've only just met, and yet my heart won't stop beating! We share feverish breaths, spending a dreamlike night together, but...

A reverse harem romance with the gorgeous noblemen of the Neo-Heian period! Who will win Kaguya's heart...?

(Source: Brite Publishing)

title.english: Reborn As A One-In-A-Thousand-Years Beauty
title.native: 千恋～千年に一人の美少女に転生したので雅なイケメンと恋します！～
title.romaji: Senren: Sennen ni Hitori no Bishoujo ni Tensei shita no de Miyabi na Ikemen to Koishimasu!

212366.description: Note: Originally published in Comic Yuri-Hime 2026 July issue.

212367.description:
"I have no interest in children!" Yuzuki, a high school girl with a fetish for older men, is reincarnated as the villainess in an otome game. Ignoring the handsome princes who are the love interests, she launches a fierce attack on the handsome older knight commander, a supporting character!? An isekai reincarnation romantic comedy featuring a handsome older man and a villainess, originating from "Shosetsuka ni Narou"! !

(Source: Comic Boost, translated)

title.native: 悪役令嬢はオジサマに夢中です
title.romaji: Akuyaku Reijou wa Oji-sama ni Muchuudesu

212368.description: Note: Originally published in Comic Yuri-Hime 2026 July issue.

title.native: 浪人なんてろくでもない！

212369.description:
The one she truly fell in love with was Earth. A story about an alien who is self-conscious about her appearance.

An alien fell in love. The object of her affection was… “Earth.” To her, everything on Earth looks adorable. One day, a life form arrived from space with the intention of conquering Earth. To protect Earth, she must return to her true form and fight. If she stops being human in front of humans, they might find her repulsive. Even so, she will fight. For the sake of her beloved Earth, and for you, who are so cute—

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Note: Originally self-published on Twitter and Pixiv under the title "Watashitachi no Koto ga Suki na Kawaikunai Uchuujin no Hanashi (私たちのことが好きな可愛くない宇宙人の話)", was then licensed by Kadokawa for commercial release under the present title.
synonyms: 私たちのことが好きな可愛くない宇宙人の話
Watashitachi no Koto ga Suki na Kawaikunai Uchuujin no Hanashi

title.native: 旦那様、ビジネスライクに行きましょう！ ～下町令嬢の華麗なる身代わりウェディング～
title.romaji: Danna-sama, Businesslike ni Ikimashou!: Shitamachi Reijou no Kare Inaru Nigawari Ending

title.native: 傲慢公爵は“偽り修道女”の献身的な愛を買う
title.romaji: Gouman Koushaku wa “Itsuwari Shuudu Onna” no Kenshin Teki na Ai wo Kau

title.native: 傲慢公爵は“偽り修道女”の献身的な愛を買う
title.romaji: Gouman Koushaku wa “Itsuwari Shuudu Onna” no Kenshin Teki na Ai wo Kau

title.native: 転生したら魔王の娘 うっかり最凶魔族をスキルで魅了しちゃって甘すぎる溺愛から逃げられません！
title.romaji: Tensei Shitara Maou no Musume Ukkari Sai Kyo Mazoku wo Sukiru de Miryo Shichatte Ama Sugiru Dekiai kara Nigeraremasen!

title.native: ド田舎出身の芋令嬢、なぜか公爵に溺愛される
title.romaji: Doinaka Shusshin no Imo Reijou, Nazeka Koushaku ni Dekiai Sareru

synonyms: The Taste of a Childhood Friend

212379.description:
Cho Seung-Hun, a first-year employee, has just started working in the HR department of a game company. Together with his devilish boss, who takes human form, he helps the company grow rapidly…

What is the devil’s true goal behind this growth, and what choice will the human make once he realizes it?

(Source: Naver Series, translated)

212380.description:
The industry’s top headhunter launches a survival project, leading five job-hunting underdogs! The “moment of truth," where you force your cover letter past the application cutoff and shatter the interviewer’s rigid mindset with your image! Can we really pull this off? What is the true story of these human resources (HR) professionals that unfolds beyond the doors of employment? The story of a mysterious headhunter and job seekers on the brink of despair!

(Source: Justoon, translated)
synonyms: Human Resource: The Moment of Truth
How to Heal a Sick Childhood Friend

212382.description:
Jacqueline grew up in a forgotten land at the border of three nations, where survival was never guaranteed. In a world that gave her nothing, her younger sibling was her whole world. But everything changed the day her sibling awakened as a rare "special beastkin." Taken away by the state in the name of protection, they were torn from Jacqueline's side. Left with nothing, Jacqueline was forced to take on one more burden from the very person responsible for separating them—Margo, her sibling's guardian. This time, it was a mysterious young bird beastkin named Demi. Years later, fate brings Jacqueline and Demi together once again... but their reunion may change everything.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: Let Loose

212384.description:
Only two students in the entire school, and a crush on one another. No rivals! Makura-chan transfers from a city school to a rural school. But her new school is a rural school with only two students, including herself. Her only classmate, Mu-chan, is a clumsy and laid-back boy. But Makura-chan finds herself drawn to him for some reason...? A lighthearted and heartwarming romantic comedy about two people who are all alone!

(Source: Comic Ambre, translated)

title.native: ふたりがっこう～全校生徒2名、片想い～

212387.description:
The first official comic anthology from Chilla's Art, a popular indie horror game maker with over 60 million YouTube gameplay videos! "Night Shift Incident'', "Closing Case'', "Yuki Onna'', "Kidnapping Incident'', and "Accident Property'' - 5 titles of great horror games have been made into comics!!

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title.native: 夜勤事件 Chilla's Art アンソロジーコミック
title.romaji: Yakin Jiken Chilla's Art Anthology Comic

212388.description:
After Kanoko meets Sosuke at a bar, they share a tender night together... only to meet again at work the next day! Sosuke turns out to be the boss of a rival company that shares a floor with Kanoko's in the same office building. To make things worse, he tells Kanoko that he's liked her for a while... She turns him down, saying she can't date someone from a rival company, but when his fingers and tongue start to wander, she doesn't have the strength to refuse! It feels so good, she's about to lose her mind...!

(Source: Daitosha)

title.english: The Beastly Young Boss Next Door
title.native: となりの野獣は年下社長
title.romaji: Tonari no Yajuu wa Toshishita Shachou

212389.description:
Dominant Alpha Grayson Miller has one life goal: finding his one true love, and upon seeking a fortune teller’s advice, he is promised two things: they work with fire, and they have a chest that is out of this world. When Grayson passes out at a fiery accident from a dominant Omega’s pheromones, he wakes up convinced he’s finally found the one. Taking a job at the local fire station to track down his mystery match, his first day sparks an immediate, explosive rivalry with a fellow firefighter named Dane. Has Grayson met his match, or is he about to get burned?

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: Desire Me If You Can

212390.description:
Raku Hirano, a 25-year-old freeter working at a local Thai restaurant, is known as Nora by those around her. After her shifts, she hangs out with friends until morning, and sometimes has physical relationships with strangers... She has no savings, no place to live (she's freeloading at a friend's house), and no idea what the future holds. But she actually quite likes her carefree life. One day, however, Nora's every day life—no, her entire life—is shaken to its core!?

(Source: Shuro, translated)

212392.description:
"Oh no... if he moves his hand like that, I'll...!" Rio Kasugai, an office worker with a knack for fortune-telling, reluctantly does a love fortune for her boss, Shinya Fukamachi, whom she really can't stand. That night, she has a startling dream of her...having sex with him?! This dream makes her hyper-aware of him, and she finds it hard to contain the heat of arousal building within her. Then, one evening after work, the two find themselves getting close, leading to...?! Buckle up for a wild ride of romance, mystery, and suspense with a headstrong office worker and her snide boss!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: I Don't Love You but I Want to Sleep With You
title.native: 好きじゃないけど、抱いてください

212393.description:
"I've decided. I'm going to spoil you rotten!"

Kensuke, an older student whom Tamaki had admired since high school, moves into the apartment next to hers. Kensuke had become a successful CEO of an IT company and acquired a huge fortune, moving up in the world. In order to protect Tamaki, a magnet for useless men who is being harassed by her ex-boyfriend, Kensuke decides to pretend to be her boyfriend! In exchange, Tamaki must clean up his messy apartment. Although it was only supposed to be a pretense, Tamaki is flustered by the older man's gentle protection...

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

title.english: This CEO is Determined to Date Me!
title.native: 強引社長の過剰な独占愛
title.romaji: Gouin Shachou no Kajou na Dokusen Ai

212394.description:
"Be my attendant." What? A lame woman like me can't serve a man in that way!

I was a plain, unfeminine woman, but before I knew it, I woke up in the world of the game I was playing! And to think that I'd become the villainous young lady Alissa, a character I hate the most... On top of that, Alissa is on the verge of being sent to a dirty old man as a prostitute by her evil sister, the queen, under the guise of being a saintess! As Alissa tries to escape from the royal palace, a wild and mysterious handsome man assists her rescue. But the forceful man orders her to perform serve him in exchange for his help!

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

title.english: The Villainess is Refusing the Saintess Route (and All the Hot Romantic Interests That Come With It!)
title.native: 悪役令嬢は聖女ルートを望まない ～私、イケメン攻略なんてしたくないんです～
title.romaji: Akuyaku Reijou wa Seijo Route wo Nozomanai: Watashi, Ikemen Kouryaku Nante Shitakunain desu

212395.description:
"Show me everything..." As he gazes at me with his serious eyes, with every intense thrust of his toned body, both my heart and body throb deep inside... I didn't know I could still feel like that... Ordinary office worker, Marika Kudo, is overwhelmed with work everyday. Even when her fiance breaks up with a single text, she felt sad about how it did not affect her... That night, the words of a kind man she met at a bar made her feel so good, she ends up sleeping with him as if to fill in her loneliness. That sex was too passionate to be called comfort... Just as she decides to keep it in her heart as a memory, the new president appointed at her company turns out to be the man who had shared the night with her until the morning...?

(Source: CLLENN)

title.english: Starting Love from One Amazing Night ~The Famous President Tenderly Makes Me Wet Again Tonight~
title.native: 最高の一夜から始める恋～セレブ社長は今夜も私を甘く濡らす～
title.romaji: Saikou no Ichiya Kara Hajimeru Koi: Celebrity Shachou wa Konya mo Watashi wo Amaku Nurasu

212396.description:
"I still dream about my ex..." Narumi, who works as a wedding planner, longed for a romantic wedding and married life. Then, her ex-boyfriend, Mizuki, whom she broke up with five years ago, comes to work at the hotel where she is employed as the assistant manager after an overseas assignment. And to make matters worse, he moves into the room next door in the employee dormitory! "Do you remember? How well we got along physically?" Mizuki, who has become even more attractive, whispers sweetly, and the familiar touch of his fingertips brings back pleasant memories. She wants Mizuki... Just as her mind begins to yearn for him, she remembers the reason they broke up... he was a confirmed bachelor! Despite their differing views on marriage, two people irresistibly drawn to each other weave a realistic adult love story—

(Source: Kasakura Publishing, translated)

title.native: 耽溺ホテル～5年ぶりの再会、抱かれたらもう逃れられない～
title.romaji: Tandeki Hotel: 5-Nen Buri no Saikai, Dakaretara mou Nogarerarenai

212397.description:
"I can't wait any longer, so prepare yourself." Wedding planner Itsuki makes her living by helping the relationships of others. Her own love life, however, exists only on dating apps, and can only be described as a complete failure. Dumped by ten people in a row, her daily routine consists of venting about her failures to her childhood friend, Tomo. Though they often butt heads, Tomo is a constant source of comfort for Itsuki. One night, however, a drunken bout of joking around leads to an unexpected kiss! Itsuki's body can't help but react to Tomo's soft lips and warm fingertips. ""Just let me do you."" When his eyes full of masculine desires meet Itsuki's, all resistance melts away, along with the possibility of remaining friends. Tomo was the last guy she thought she'd ever consider, so is it really okay to be having sex with him?!"

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: Just Let Me Do You - Sleeping with My Childhood Friend
title.native: 絶対ない幼馴染とワケありなSEX～いい加減、俺に抱かれろよ
title.romaji: Zettai nai Osananajimi to Wakeari na SEX: Iikagen, Ore ni Dakarero yo

212398.description:
The servants and Lady Florentina's family noticed that Lady Florentina seems to have love sickness. What is truly going on with her?

Note: Published in Gekkan Flowers 2008-01

212402.description: Note: Published in Gensou Fantasy Vol. 6: Ginrei Yawa

212403.description:
You cut my red string of fate!

One morning, Alex Hubert, a student in the knight department at Howard Royal Academy, suddenly begins to see countless red threads. The beautiful outcast Sarah Crowleagh tells him that these threads are "red strings of fate." But she cuts Alex's red string without a second thought! Alex is outraged by Sarah's selfish behavior, which has earned her the reputation of being the "witch of breakups" who breaks up lovers, but he realizes that she is actually cutting the threads of unhappy couples. Alex can't help but worry about Sarah, who is not afraid to play the bad guy and continues to isolate herself.

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

title.english: Once Again, Miss Sarah Crowleagh Cuts the Red Strings of Fate
title.native: 伯爵令嬢サラ・クローリアは今日も赤い糸を切る
title.romaji: Hakushaku Reijou Sarah Cloria wa Kyou mo Akai Ito wo Kiru

212404.description:
Aletheia, a member of the Magic Corps, 1st Division, possesses a rare magical power known as “Forgetting Magic.” Even the notoriously cold and ruthless Division Commander Christoph treats her with kid gloves, and she finds comfort in their ambiguous relationship. However, something is about to shatter her peaceful life…!?

(Source: Hana to Yume, translated)

title.native: 忘却後のアレーティア

212405.description:
The plan of the incredibly close sisters... is to show what's what to their mother who always was prejudiced against the older sister!

"I know very well that a parent's love isn't always equal... but I'm fine as long as I have my little sister with me!" Amanda is plain and always ridiculed when compared to her beautiful younger sister, Adeline. Her parents ignored her and other people's words hurt her... but only at first. After Amanda learned how Adeline truly felt, all Amanda could think about was how to become the best big sister to Adeline as she could be. If she had the time to be hurt, then she could improve herself for Adeline's sake! In other words, she became someone with the mental strength of steel and an obsession with her little sister. Their mother had always irrationally doted on Adeline, so they made a plan to escape her clutches. When they put it into motion...

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

title.english: My Beautiful Sister and I

title.native: 私たちはデキてません！～初夜失敗した元婚約者と王命婚でやり直し～
title.romaji: Watashitachi wa Dekitemasen!: Shoya Shippaishita Moto Konyakusha to Oumei Kon de Yarinaoshi

title.native: 泣き顔百合アンソロジー

212408.description:
Angenica's engagement is called off after her stepsister Veronica sleeps with her betrothed. On top of that, Veronica's engagement to the rumored "Brutish Count" is transferred to Angenica, forcing her into a suspicious marriage of unknown circumstances. After all the years of hard work Angenica had put into managing her family's estate after her mother passed away, she's now being driven out of her own home and into the arms of a man known as the Brutish Count Lloyd. Others that were engaged to the count are rumored to have gone mad and run away from him!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: Angenica the Betrayed and the Brutish Count
title.native: 寝取られアンジェニカと鬼畜伯爵

212409.description:
A spin-off story of Utsuro no Shouzou.

Note: Published in OPERA Vol. 73.

212410.description:
"My life is over..." What if there was an ideal item that could solve your problems at that moment?! A bizarre marriage story about girls chasing their utopia who encounter mysterious gadgets!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: 理想郷女子図鑑 ～私の結婚生活、とっても幸せです～
title.romaji: Risoukyou Joshi Zukan: Watashi no Kekkon Seikatsu, Tottemo Shiawase desu

212414.description:
1. Ore-sama Joushi, Gyakushuu Shitara Mesuiki Shichaimashita (俺様上司、逆襲したらメスイキしちゃいました) [Takayuki Shidatsu]
2. Morahara Kunjoushi ni Sex Gekokujou (モラハラクソ上司にセックス下剋上) [Wasabi Ochazuke]
3. Gaman Dekinai Inran Shachou ni Oshioki Ecchi (我慢できない淫乱社長にお仕置きエッチ) [Kotaro Yamada]
4. No.1 Host, Hamerare Obakan Mesu ni Naru (No.1ホスト、ハメられ暴かれメスになる) [Renji]
5. Guess Joushi: Mesuana Kaihatsu Kiroku (ゲス上司・メス穴開発記録) [Hyougo Kijima]

title.native: 鬼上司を泣くまでメスイキさせたいBL
title.romaji: Oni Joushi wo Naku made Mesuiki Sasetai BL

title.native: 裏アカ上司を暴いてメス堕ちさせるBL
title.romaji: Uraaka Joushi wo Abaite Mesu Ochisaseru BL

212417.description:
Eo Ja-Seo is a weak and timid swordsman--until luck and misunderstandings make him look like a formidable master. As his name spreads through the martial arts world, one question remains: how long can he survive as a legend?

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: The Accidental Legend

212420.description:
Stranded in the snowy mountainside!! And to make matters worse, she's stuck with that annoying boy…!?

Note: Originally published in Margaret magazine 2026 No. 6.

212422.description:
Anita has had a crush on the duke's son, Lanslo, since they were little. When her family's business fails and her father goes missing, Lanslo is the only person she can lean on for help. Since Anita is currently a penniless commoner, Lanslo offers to marry her to ensure her safety and well-being. Despite Anita's love being unrequited, the couple have an amicable married life... until Lanslo finds a new lover. Now Anita knows it's time for her to back off and let Lanslo be happy... or is it?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.english: To My Husband's New Wife

212423.description:
“Scramble Love,” a massive hit Japanese romance comedy manga that has sold over 10 million copies. I’ve channeled the spirit of Kim Yu-Seong, a minor extra in that manga I’ve never even read. But wait, turns out this guy is a hardcore otaku who even does cosplay, right? To live a comfortable life free from suspicion, I’ll play the part of an otaku extra and devour every romance comedy out there. But why do all the heroine clichés kick in whenever I’m with you? And not just one, but multiple? This is a real problem!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: I was Thrown into an Unfamiliar Manga
I Was Thrown Into an Unknown Manga
I Possessed A Character in A Manga I Don't Know

212424.description: A compilation of the authors one-shots published in JUNE.
synonyms: Hitodenashi no Koi: belne JUNE Shoki Sakuhinshuu
ひとでなしの戀人 belne JUNE初期作品集

212427.description:
You should stay by my side rather than with a man who can't even promise you the future.

Sana had promised to marry her boss, Mr. Kouta. However, one day, Mr. Kouta brought his pregnant fiancee to the office! Shocked and devastated, Sana ran out of work and broke down crying. Suddenly, the company president, Mr. Tougo, appeared before her. Although it was their first meeting, he comforted her with a kiss, and by the next day, she found herself promoted to be his secretary, leaving Sana completely confused. To make things even more bewildering, Tougo came to pick Sana up at her home, whisking her away on a private, overnight business trip.

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

title.english: After Being Dumped Right Before Marriage, the CEO's Obsession Began
title.native: 結婚寸前で捨てられたら社長の溺愛がはじまりました
title.romaji: Kekkon Sunzen de Suteraretara Shachou no Dekiai ga Hajimarimashita

212428.description:
A mature relationship with a super-intelligent, handsome CEO is quite stimulating for a girl with a bob and glasses...

Momoka, a librarian, has been so absorbed in books that she hasn't experienced romance even once in 25 years. One day, she meets Tokio, a handsome man who is like a prince from a romance novel. Momoka is captivated by him, but for some reason, Tokio knows her name. He then holds her hands and suddenly asks her out on a date! It's Momoka's first date, but Tokio's gentlemanly behavior eases her tension. And at the end of the date, he gives her a sweet kiss!

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

title.english: The Possessive CEO's Wallflower Bride
title.native: 独占愛欲～地味で冴えない私がエリート社長の花嫁に任命されました～
title.romaji: Dokusen Aiyoku: Jimi de Saenai Watashi ga Elite Shachou no Hanayome ni Ninmeisaremashita

212429.description:
What will you wish for in exchange for your lost love?

Broken Heart Hall is a shop where a witch grants wishes in exchange for broken hearts. Matilda, the daughter of the Commander of the Knights, is scorned by her cheating fiancé; Freya, the daughter of a marquis, is abandoned by her ruthless fiancé; and Emily is toyed with by her womanizing fiancé from her arranged marriage... What wishes did these women make to the witch?

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

title.english: Broken Heart Hall ~Paying the Witch with Lost Love~
title.native: 失恋堂～魔女へのお支払いは、失った恋で～
title.romaji: Shitsurendou: Majo e no Oshiharai wa, Ushinatta Koi de

synonyms: The Baby Villain Who Foretells the Future
The Oracle of the Villainous Baby

212431.description:
Koyuki, an office worker pushed to her limits by grueling labor at an incredibly exploitative company, accidentally falls to her death out of exhaustion. When she wakes up, she finds herself standing in line for a job interview run by demons. Without even knowing what she’s done wrong, her second working life begins — in Neo Hell!!

(Source: Comic Fuz, translated)
synonyms: Death is not the end of hard labor

title.native: 死んで定時が来るものか
title.romaji: Shinde Teiji ga Kuru Mono ka

212432.description:
Ito, who loves to watch Anime all alone, has a twin sister, Oto, who is an actress known all over Japan. One day, Oto disappears...and Ito has to take her place! Oto is married to a famous actor Manato, and Ito needs to live with him...someone who reminds Ito of her favorite character in the Anime! Soon Ito finds out that their marriage is fake, but Manato seems to have a secret... When Ito falls in love with him, he starts to change...what is his intention? An awkward love story.

(Source: Kadokawa)

title.english: Wifeswap: How I Wound Up Married to My Twin's Husband -Love Fell into the Palm of My Hand-
title.native: 双子な私たちの入れ替わり婚 ―オトした愛は、イトせず手のひらに。―
title.romaji: Futago na Watashitachi no Irekawari Kon: Otoshita Ai wa, Itosezu Tenohira ni

212433.description:
Mame and Kuro are two adorable cats living with their devoted owner in a pretty purrfect life! Unbeknownst to them, their owner often frets about what would happen to her beloved furbabies in various “what-if” scenarios that no little kitty would understand. Take a look at the fantastic journey and adventures of these pampered pets in situations they―hopefully―never have to face.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: The cat who thought there was no such thing as "what if" coming

title.english: The Cat Who Didn't Believe in “What-ifs”
title.native: もしもなんて来ないと思ってた猫
title.romaji: Moshimo Nante Konai to Omotteta Neko

212436.description:
Was this reunion a mere coincidence, too good to be true? Or was it a destined encounter?

Ayaha's very first arranged marriage meeting ended in disaster when she arrived late, only to be met with a single word: "Rejected." Convinced they would never cross paths again, she was shocked to encounter her would-be fiance, the wealthy heir Mitsuaki Kasama, the very next day.

This seemingly impossible coincidence made Mitsuaki suspect Ayaha had orchestrated it all, sparking her defiance. She lashed out in anger and stormed off. Yet just a few days later, Mitsuaki appeared before her again, declaring, "I came to see you."

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

title.english: Overly Sweet Marriage
title.native: 溺甘婚～エリート御曹司が私をご所望です～
title.romaji: Dekiama Kon: Elite Onzoushi ga Watashi wo Goshomou desu

title.native: 夜明けの声をきいてよ
title.romaji: Yoake no Koe wo Kiite yo

212438.description:
At twenty-nine, I find myself thinking a lot as I approach thirty and the start of my thirties. Compared to friends enjoying happy marriages or those who’ve achieved their dreams, I feel so insignificant. At work, I’m looked down upon because I’m a contract worker, and at home, I’m pressured about marriage. I try to tell myself, “This is fine. Everyone lives like this,” but overnight, my plans for marriage and my hopes for a permanent position vanish into thin air. Spring, entering her 30s with empty hands.

(Source: Naver, translated)

212440.description:
Ha-Jun despises cults with a passion. After all, a fraudulent religion stole his grandmother's savings and left her to die, forcing him into a relentless life of hard labor. Then comes a freezing winter night when he finds a barefoot child wandering the streets. Taking the boy in, Ha-Jun discovers a horrifying truth: the child is the worshipped deity of the very cult that ruined his family. Driven to the brink, Ha-Jun vows to destroy this god, only to face an impossible twist. The deity begins showing inexplicable affection toward him, revealing a dark, twisted destiny tied between them.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: How To Kill A God

212441.description:
Determined to make it as a stunt actor in Hong Kong, Baek Seung-Hyeon becomes an innocent pawn in his team leader's corrupt scheme. Forced into the room of acclaimed director Liu Tian Hua, Seung-Hyeon is immediately branded as a manipulative opportunistic leech. Tian Hua makes no secret of his disgust, but Seung-Hyeon refuses to be trampled on. As production begins, Tian Hua is forced to witness Seung-Hyeon’s true character and raw talent. Caught between his initial contempt and growing obsession, the director finds himself captivated by the very man he once looked down upon.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: A Silver Lining

212442.description:
Ethan Yoon is a rising star researcher at the pharmaceutical giant Neurix until he is kidnapped on his commute. The demand from gang boss Ramon Garcia is simple: synthesize Exidrine, the deadly drug Ethan engineered. Forced to work as an unwilling chemist, Ethan risks everything on a desperate break for freedom, only to end up staring down the barrel of a gun. Just as the trigger is about to be pulled, a mysterious stranger crashes in to save his life. With his savior demanding to know if he truly created the drug, Ethan finds himself dragged out of one trap and straight into an even deadlier firefight.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: Trustfall

212443.description:
The Saturns, a slumbering baseball team, are once again stuck in last place this year. Their previous manager was fired before the All-Star break, and 17-year-old Enishi Kera has taken over as manager for the second half of the season! A current high school student and a 17-year Saturns fan! Will her cheerful personality change this losing team...? Aim for a miraculous comeback victory!!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 奪ったのではありません、お姉様が捨てたのです
title.romaji: Ubatta node wa Arimasen, Onee-sama ga Suteta no desu

title.native: 契約結婚のその後　～追い出した夫が私の価値を知るまで～
title.romaji: Keiyaku Kekkon no Sonogo: Oidashita Otto ga Watashi no Kachiwoshiru made

212446.description:
Natsuko arrives at the Hagiwara mansion to work as a maid, only to discover she bears an uncanny resemblance to the recently deceased mistress of the household.

Note: Published in Mystery I vol. 8

title.english: Devil in the Water

title.native: 婚約破棄されたので、国の外れで錬金術姫になりました！～自由になった途端、隣国の王太子や精霊王や竜族から愛されています～
title.romaji: Konyaku Haki Sareta node, Koku no Hazure de Renkinjutsu Hime ni Narimashita!: Jiyuu ni Natta Totan, Ringoku no Outaishi ya Seirei-ou ya Ryuuzoku kara Aisareteimasu

212448.description:
A cat who watches over her master and the mysterious woman who resides in their house.

Published in Mystery I vol. 7

title.english: The House of Magnolias

212450.description:
Keishiro returns to his household, only to find out that his grandfather adopted a young girl into the family before passing. She brings with her a painting of a beautiful woman, that is said to have been a lover of Keishiro's missing great uncle — a painter who was said to bear a strong resemblance to Keishiro himself...

Note: Published in Mystery I vol. 5

title.english: Taking the Color of Flowers

title.native: 彗星乙女後宮伝～男装の女騎士、異国であやしいお役目に就きました～
title.romaji: Suisei Otome Koukyuu-den: Dansou no Onna Kishi, Ikoku de Ayashii wo Yakume ni Tsukimashita

212452.description:
A man arrives at a remote residence to visit his wife. She's been living there because of her fragile health. They reaffirm their love vows, but among the summer dizziness, something’s amiss...

Note: Published in Mystery I vol.9

title.english: In the Depth of Summer

212453.description:
A woman whose lover is missing receives the visit of a black cat every night.

Note: Published in Mystery I vol. 10

title.english: The Vigil

212454.description:
A woman wakes up with amnesia after surviving a fall from a cliff.

Note: Published in Mystery I vol. 10

title.english: The Blod Red Shadow

212455.description:
"I want to expose your skin and kiss every inch of you." A devoted and handsome prince and the daughter of a margrave who loves herbs!

"I had no idea how possessive I could be." Passionate kisses and gentle caresses... Her body melts sweetly as he makes love to her... Rosemary, the margrave's daughter with a love for medicinal herbs, serves herbal tea to the knights every day. Meanwhile, the third prince, Jaylas, is appointed as the new captain of the knights. He is handsome and overwhelmingly charming, but he initially bans her from coming to the knights' post. They soon become attracted to each other, and he eventually proposes to her. However, things suddenly change when Jaylas is named the heir to the throne! Rosemary worries about her ability to become the queen, but his love for her is unstoppable!

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

title.english: The Princely Captain of the Knights Wants to Marry His Herbal Lady
title.native: 王子な騎士団長は薬草好きの令嬢を溺愛してめとりたい
title.romaji: Ouji na Kishi Danchou wa Yakusou Suki no Reijou wo Dekiai Shite Metoritai

212457.description:
"I want him to touch me more..." The first temptation for the clumsy emperor!

"Your Majesty... please touch me more."" His sweet caresses melt her body... Princess Euphie is hailed as a fairy princess for her fragile appearance. By order of her mother, the queen, she is to marry Diethart, the emperor of a distant empire, and falls in love with him at first sight at their wedding ceremony. However, for some reason, Diethart refuses to lay a finger on Euphie. She is suspicious of the days that have passed without even a wedding night and pretends to be hesitant to enter his private room, only to find a giant birdcage there! Realizing his true intentions, Euphie enters the birdcage herself and seduces Diethart. The risky acts between the two gradually escalate...!"

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

title.english: The Emperor's Secret Birdcage
title.native: 皇帝陛下と秘めやかな鳥かご～新妻が可愛すぎて限界突破しました!!～
title.romaji: Koutei Heika to Himeya kana Torikago: Niizuma ga Kawaisugite Genkai Toppa shimashita!!

212458.description:
"If you look away, I'll kiss you." Her first love and the man she hasn't seen in seven years is the next CEO who's famous within the company!

Maiko reunites with her childhood friend Kyouichi, the son of the CEO of the major cosmetics company she had gotten her dream job in. Kyo was Maiko's first love, but seven years ago, he left to go overseas and they had been out of contact ever since then. Maiko was hurt, thinking that her love was unrequited, but after they reunite, Kyo acts just like her boyfriend! He's a possessive sweet-talker with kisses that enthrall her. What is Maiko to do?

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)
synonyms: I will be loved by the next president when I see him

title.english: The Next CEO Has Been All Over Me from the Moment We Reunited
title.native: 次期社長に再会したら溺愛されてます
title.romaji: Jiki Shachou ni Saikai shitara Dekiaisaretemasu

212460.description:
The dream she longs to fulfill, is there on the dojo mat— Natori Fukami is a girl still in mourning, after losing her older sister, a fellow judoka, in an accident. She finally finds a spark in her life once more in the winter of her third year of junior high, when she meets Shizuha, a girl who idolizes her deceased sister. A gentile and fleeting girl-meets-girl story depicting the strength of young women.

(Source: Sunday Webry, translated)

212461.description:
The man who bought me at a slave auction is... my former disciple?

The duke sorcerer has been in love with her for ten years!

Linya is a demi-human who is unable to use magic due to one of her horns being broken. She was chased out of her homeland, the country of demi-humans, and made a living by selling potions in the humans' country. One day, Linya makes a deal with a black market salesman to buy a young slave, Gil. Gil has an enormous amount of magical power, something that's rare in humans, so Linya decides to make him her disciple. However, Gil is extremely clingy!

They became unusually close, and the kiss he gave her as he transferred his magical powers to her was so sweet and passionate, it was electric.

Then, three years after Linya and Gil started living together, someone appeared, looking for Gil...

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

title.english: The Marriage of a Magicless Witch: Her Rise to Fame After Her Former Disciple Falls for Her!
title.native: できそこない魔女の嫁入り～かつての弟子からこじらせ溺愛されて成り上がります～
title.romaji: Dekisokonai Majo no Yomeiri: Katsute no Deshi kara Kojirase Dekiaisarete Nariagarimasu

212462.description:
In a magic spell gone awry, two saints are summoned instead of one! Of the two girls who appear in this other world, the plain-looking Sayo is cruelly rejected by the kingdom's prince. Despite being brought there against her will, Sayo is deemed unwanted and put to work as a servant in the castle. One day, she happens upon a gate in the forest. On passing through, she encounters a large, fluffy beast and an ill-mannered but handsome boy mage...!

In the mage's tower at the farthest reaches of the kingdom, Sayo is comforted by the fluffy beast as the mage proceeds to make her his plaything. Her new life as a maid in another world is about to begin...

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: I'm A Maid To A Boy Mage!? -Summoned To Another World By Accident!-
title.native: 聖女召喚に巻き込まれたオマケ女子、ショタ魔術師の家政婦になります
title.romaji: Seijo Shoukan ni Makikomareta Omake Joshi, Shota Majutsushi no Kaseifu ni narimasu

212463.description: Note: Chapter 1 was previously released as a one-shot in the Tokyo Senritsu Kitan (東京戦慄奇譚) anthology Volume 3.

212464.description:
The sixth Demon King, Ilvizora, flees before his final battle with the hero. Having abandoned the fight and run away, Ilvizora encounters Enea, a human girl who has never known freedom. As a slave, she believes that humans are more terrifying than demons. Ilvizora ends up helping Enea, and they begin traveling together... The story depicts the escape of a Demon King who wants to live peacefully after abandoning everything, and a former slave girl.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: イルビゾーラの逃避行
聖女の姉ですが、なぜか魅惑の公爵様に仕えることになりました
title.romaji: Seijo no Ane desu ga, Naze ka Miwaku no Koushaku-sama ni Tsukaeru Koto ni Narimashita

synonyms: make me fall for you this time

title.native: いっそ今度は沼らせて

212467.description:
One day, shy high school first-year Akira Seki suddenly finds himself favored by a ghost cat he makes eye contact with. The cat is a bit of a pain, but little by little, his life becomes more enjoyable when he's with it... A heartwarming short story about "me," who's a bit of an outcast in class, and "a cat," who floats freely in the air!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

212468.description:
"Looks like you can't hold back." The tolerance and sweet techniques of the older man are melting her, body and soul.

Lene, the youngest daughter of a margrave, was forced to marry a rich nobleman by her greedy, older half-sisters despite still mourning the loss of her kind father. Lene had completely given up, but the handsome Duke Ladias, formerly a soldier under her father's command, showed her warmth and saved her from her predicament. "I'll fill you up." His gentle kisses unlocked her lonely heart. Her pure body that had only ever known fleeting love before was rampaged nightly by his sweet whispers and lewd touches. Then, one day, her older sisters discover her whereabouts!

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

title.english: Every Night, I Whisper Love to You ~The Noble Soldier's Lewd Troubles~
title.native: 夜ごと、あなたに愛を囁く～軍人公爵の淫らな悩み～
title.romaji: Yorugoto, Anata ni Ai wo Sasayaku: Gunjin Koushaku no Midara na Nayami

212469.description: Note: Published in 5 parts on konnyaku's PixivFANBOX account.

212470.description: Shigure Kurimoto meets Junna Amamori by chance. As they get excited talking about books and Japanese rock music, Shigure begins to glimpse a more intense and clingy side to the otherwise aloof Junna.

title.native: 雨森潤奈は湿度が高い
title.romaji: Amamori Junna wa Shitsudo ga Takai

title.native: あんてぃくうす -古道具屋のメイドさん-

212472.description:
Koya, an ordinary salaryman, is unexpectedly reincarnated into another world. To fully enjoy the otherworldly life he's always dreamed of, he cleverly receives cheat skills from a god and is reborn as Cliff Bold, the second son of a Marquis family. Cliff enjoys a peaceful life, happily going through typical tropes like welcoming his adorable companion and rescuing a princess using his skills. However, even classic tropes come with trouble...!? Will he be able to achieve his ideal life in another world!? The long-awaited comic adaptation of the heartwarming fantasy of the Marquis's second son in another world!

(Source: AlphaPolis, translated)

title.native: 辺境伯家次男は転生チートライフを楽しみたい
title.romaji: Henkyou Hakke Jinan wa Tensei Cheat Life wo Tanoshi Mitai

212473.description:
Koharu Satou, a hotel employee, has a boyfriend, Rintarou Orisaka, whom she loves dearly. They were childhood friends who made a promise to see each other again after he had moved away as a child, and they finally did. Shy and inexperienced, Koharu allows her him to take charge during sex. However, things take an unexpected turn when Koharu helps out at a new hotel and bumps into the real Rintarou. She learns that the man she's seeing is actually Rintarou's twin brother, Outarou.

"I'll stop if you tell me you love me," Outarou says, as he violates her with pleasure now that his secret is out...

(Source: Pachika, translated)

title.english: Trapped in Bed With My False Destiny
title.native: ぐちゃぐちゃ絡まる、赤い糸 ~偽りの運命は、私を抱いて逃がさない~
title.romaji: Guchagucha Karamaru, Akai Ito: Itsuwari no Unmei wa, Watashi wo Daite Nigasanai

212474.description:
Airi, a daughter of a small bakery owner, was hired by a large food producing company. It was a dream-come-true for her. On her way home, she was suddenly taken to the CEO's house to meet their son, Akinari. He was an Otaku, loving this character "Love-chan" so much that he refused to marry anyone in the real world. And this Love-chan looked exactly like Airi...! Airi starts to live with Akinari, and in return her father's bakery gets support from her company. Akinari is handsome and sweet...Airi starts to have feelings for him while working close to him in the company. But she is not sure...does Akinari loves her, or just Love-chan!?

(Source: Kadokawa)

title.english: The Noble Otaku and His 2.5 Dimensional Bride ~He's in Love with Me Because I Look Like His Favorite Character~
title.native: オタク御曹司と2.5次元花嫁 ～彼の推しキャラにそっくりなせいで溺愛されています～
title.romaji: Otaku Onzoushi to 2.5 Jigen Hanayome: Kare no Oshi Chara ni Sokkuri na Seide Dekiaisaretemasu

212475.description:
Natsu Yoshizawa finds herself abruptly transferred to product development at the bedding manufacturer where she works, and then given a coveted spot on the team designing a bed aimed at newlyweds. Spearheading the project is Moriba, a man from Natsu's hiring group who's since become a powerhouse at the company, and almost as soon as she arrives he proposes to her out of the blue...!! Well, not exactly. It turns out he just wanted to "play house," temporarily pretending to be a married couple, in order to better understand their target customers' mindset. Natsu reluctantly accepts, since after all it's just research for work, but when Moriba proceeds to treat her just like an actual wife she starts wondering if she's in over her head. He even puts on a morning pillow-talk act, whispering about how adorable she was last night as if something had actually happened between them...?! Now, hold on just a second! This really isn't what it looks like...! (Not yet, anyway.)

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: Playing House on the Job: This Isn't What It Looks Like (I Swear)!
title.native: 【社内公認】疑似夫婦-私たち(今のところはまだ)やましくありません！
title.romaji: [Shanai Kounin] Giji Fuufu: Watashitachi (Imanotokoro wa Mada) Yamashiku Arimasen!

title.native: 貧乏神のおれでもいいのか？
title.romaji: Binbougami no Ore demo Ii no ka?

212477.description:
A man who ended his previous life as an orphan was reborn as baby Bernie, surrounded by a loving family. Granted the world's only cheat job, [Magic Tool Engineer], Bernie enjoys the best crafting life with his reliable companions and fluffy divine beast!

(Source: Starts Publishing, translated)

title.native: 小さな魔道具技師のらくらく生産革命～なんでも作れるチートジョブで第二の人生謳歌する～
title.romaji: Chiisana Madougu Gishi no Rakuraku Seisan Kakumei: Nandemo Tsukureru Cheat Job de Dai ni Jinsei Ouka suru

212479.description:
"I," a salaryman in modern Japan, suddenly find myself reincarnated into a video game world... as Klaus Müller, the ugly, villainous son destined to be the butt of the plot!! Realizing that following the original game's plot will lead to his condemnation and execution by the hero, he begins to take action to avoid his disastrous ending. Through hard work, Klaus earns the trust of those around him, including the heroine and his family. But then, unintentionally, he achieves great success and attracts a lot of attention...!? The epic fantasy of a scumbag's triumphant return begins now!!

(Source: AlphaPolis, translated)

title.native: 嫌われ者の悪役令息に転生したのに、なぜか周りが放っておいてくれない
title.romaji: Kirawaremono no Akuyaku Reisoku ni Tensei Shita noni, Nazeka Mawari ga Hanatte Oitekurenai

212480.description:
1. Inu to Shigoto wa Kemuri ni Makenai (犬と仕事は煙に巻けない) [Rion Nomiya]
2. Tokimeki Lilac (ときめきライラック) [Pyaa]
3. Kimi wa Hikari (君は光) [Ayu Inui]

title.native: お仕事×バディ 百合アンソロジーコミック

212481.description:
"Can you remain calm if I do this to you?" "I can...but...ahh..." "Really?" The places stroked by his passionate tongue feel so hot that my brain is going on overdrive. It all began when Homare's mother brought home a handsome yet sarcastic man to be her new live-in butler. As she holds a deep hatred for men, Homare complains to her mother, but alas she refuses to change her mind. Just when she thought things couldn't get any worse, not wanting to be the odd one out, she lies to her friends that she has a boyfriend and promises to go on a double date! Unfortunately for her, there's only one man whom she can rely upon on such short notice... Cue the start of a love lesson taught by a sensual, sharp-tongued butler!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: Milady, Please Surrender to Me
title.native: お嬢様、私に屈服してください。
title.romaji: Ojou-sama, Watashi ni Kuppuku shite kudasai.

title.native: マザー・トラップ～ママ友たちが堕ちるまで～
title.romaji: Mother Trap: Mama Tomodachi ga Ochiru Made

212484.description:
Aidie is KN Group's mascot robot that has been greeting the employees every morning. Its creator, Professor Harvey, takes Aidie on the day of his resignation and risks his life to protect it from the company. What secrets does this one robot hold?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.english: AIDIE

212485.description:
To save her kidnapped Pink Rabbit Clan, Ruby sets out to find the Black Wolf Clan to ask for their help, but ends up lost and starving in the snowy mountains. When she finally stumbles upon a carrot, she bites down hard only to hear it scream out in pain. Wait, so it wasn't a carrot?!

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: If You Are Locked Up, Please Wave A Carrot

title.english: Dangle Your Carrot if You've Been Confined

212487.description:
Gloria, the daughter of a duke, was betrayed by her fiancé and family and executed for a crime she never committed. But when she awakens, time has turned back to when she was ten years old!?
Given a second chance at life, she smiles coldly.

"I’ll make those fools taste hell."

Her unfaithful fiancé. The father who sold out his own daughter. The self-righteous saint…
She will forgive none of them.

With her status, her reputation, and the memories of her previous life, along with the knowledge of the reincarnator that once clung to her soul, she will expose their true natures and make them atone for every sin.
A merciless tale of revenge by a true villainess begins!
synonyms: The Condemnation and Revenge of the Villainess Gloria von Cordwell

title.native: 悪役令嬢グロリア・フォン・コードウェルの断罪と復讐
title.romaji: Akuyaku Reijou Gloria von Caldwell no Danzai to Fukushuu
Mirai to Kare to Papa Jijou

212490.description:
One day, a sudden meeting is held at school. The news was that Ao Tamaki of Class 2B had passed away. Kitajima, who had been going out with Ao until last week, couldn't believe his ears when he heard the news.

The beautiful and cheerful Ao was a much respected person at school, but why did she suddenly die? Kitajima wonders if it was his fault for saying goodbye to her last week, but he can't quite believe that she is dead. Then Rui, who was in the same class and club as Ao, appears in front of Kitajima.

Rui has the ability to see the past related to an object when she touches it with her feelings, so she touches a protective charm made by Ao and sees the past...

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.romaji: Ao no Shi, Boku no Koukai

title.native: 爆乳彼女の濃厚べろちゅー甘やかし搾精録
title.romaji: Bakunyuu Kanojo no Noukou Berochuu Amayakashi Sakuseiroku

title.native: ねこボラ部のみるくさん

1-3. Tsugai-gokko. (つがいごっこ。)
4-5. Mabudachi ga Ore dake no α ni Naru made (マブダチが俺だけのαになるまで)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.romaji: Mabudachi ga Ore dake no α ni Naru made

title.native: 冬木先輩を×××でわからせたい！
不本意ながら初恋です。

212498.description: Note: Includes the one-shot "Anti-glass My Lover (アンチグラス・マイラバー)" and four extra chapters.
synonyms: アンチグラス・マイラバー

212500.description:
Chitose and Kairi are stepbrothers, and both have an extreme brother complex. To Chitose, Kairi is a kind, clingy younger brother, still as adorable as ever, even as a grown up. However, the feelings Kairi has for Chitose are not those one has for a brother. Kairi begins to reveal excessive possessiveness and lust, leaving Chitose bewildered.

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: By the time this poison spreads...

title.romaji: Kono Doku ga Mawaru Koro ni wa

212501.description:
1-3. Karisome Bitch Minami-kun: Tsuzuki no Hanashi (かりそめビッチ南くん～つづきの話～); GUSH 2022-02~04
4-6. Hinekure Onodera-kun no Bukiyou na Koi (ひねくれ小野寺くんの不器用な恋)l; GUSH 2022-05~07

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: ひねくれ小野寺くんの不器用な恋

title.native: かりそめビッチ南くん～つづきの話～
title.romaji: Karisome Bitch Minami-kun: Tsuzuki no Hanashi

212502.description: Mizutani, a high school boy who can see non-human beings, meets "Tokiwa-kun" after saving him from a supernatural phenomenon. Tall, a little gloomy, lonely, clumsy...and honest, Tokiwa-kun makes Mizutani increasingly interested in him. But one afternoon after school, in a classroom trapped by something... "It's okay not to be scared, will you kiss me?" Tokiwa-kun suddenly changes...!?

title.native: とって喰わないで常葉くん

212504.description: Note: Originally self-published, was then licensed and compiled by Ichijinsha for commercial release.

212505.description:
Notes:
- All chapters were split into two parts in the original serialization and later combined in the volume release.
- Includes six extra chapters.

212506.description:
As the only son of an innkeeper in a remote village, Theo lives in guilt due to his romantic interest in men. Theo is pressed on all sides to wed his childhood friend, Maria, which he has a hard time accepting. Meanwhile, in a countryside village where mages are so rare they were believed to have gone extinct, Asa the mage arrives.

Note: Released at J.GARDEN 56.

title.native: 夜明けまではほど遠い rework

212508.hashtag: #蒼くてバカなオレたちのはじまり

title.native: 蒼くてバカなオレたちのはじまり
title.romaji: Aokute Baka na Oretachi no Hajimari

title.native: 神懸かれ、キラーチューン。
ほっぺにちゅうでもダメですか？
title.romaji: Hoppe ni Chuu demo Dame desu ka?

title.native: 児島くんの思うがまま
バーバリアンエンゼル ～両性具有、褐色民族婚姻譚～
title.romaji: Barbarian Angel: Ryouseiguyuu, Kasshoku Minzoku Konin-tan

212515.description:
“Stop whining, it’s annoying.”

The sudden change and betrayal of her husband, who had been a son-in-law by marriage. Artia, slowly wearing down in the duke’s mansion where she had no allies, threw herself into the lake, and the moment she opened her eyes again, she was transformed into a different person. Having finally shaken up high society and succeeded in a miraculous divorce, Artia begins to casually look for a second husband at the insistence of the family elders…

“After going through such a difficult divorce, why are you already looking for a husband?”

For some reason, the Second Prince Kilian, famous as the “Mad Prince", keeps hovering around her!

Will Artia be able to welcome her second husband safely?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: The Search for the Duchess's Husband
The Duchess Is Looking for a Husband

212516.description:
This series, which compiles five stories drawn under a single theme, features "love letters" as its theme. The collection includes welcome contributions from seasoned artists.

When You Get A Letter is a collection of colorful, gem-like stories ranging from romance-infused dramas, sci-fi, fairy tales, period dramas, and queer themes. Let’s take a look at five love letters that have reached both the sender, who has once written their heart on paper, and the recipient, who understands the feelings that can only be felt through a letter.

Stories featured:
1. Ineoui Yeonseo (인어의 연서) [Gold Kiwi]
2. Wanbyeokan Sarangpyeonji (완벽한 사랑편지) [Sanho]
3. Pyeonji Ilgeojwo! (편지 읽어줘!) [Lee Gong Gong Gu]
4. Donghaereul Wihayeo (동해를 위하여) [Ji-Hwan Min]
5. Yeeonui Susinin (예언의 수신인) [Angram]

212520.description:
This is a graphic novel that tells the story of witches living in a world facing a crisis due to environmental pollution and climate change. We have spent a summer where “many things crumbled silently.” Things dried up and crumbled in the scorching heat, and melted, decayed, and swept away by merciless torrential rains. Such brutal summers are getting longer with each passing year. This book is for those who endure this never-ending season with a throbbing heart that refuses to heal, lamenting the destruction and disappearance of their loved ones. Although the helplessness and guilt of feeling like there is nothing to be done amidst this massive flow of destruction sicken the mind, this book says: since there are more things that have survived than those that have lived, we must care for one another.

This is our story, and it is also the story of the witches living in Mansinnaru. In a world where nature has ailing, the grandeur of calming waves with a glance and building forests with a single gesture has become a glory of the past. Now, they are confined to a witches' sanctuary called Mansinnaru. I am slowly dying, suffering from an incurable disease that causes parts of my body to burn black like a leaf afflicted by blight. Yet, I continue to live on, planting in the field a potato I carelessly picked up at the supermarket that had sprouted, declaring it fate, and making and sharing jam-making cakes made from figs that survived heavy rains. Just like us, who strive to maintain our daily lives and care for those around us, even in moments of helplessness.

(Source: Goble, translated)

Note:
-Includes one extra chapter.
- Won the 2024 11th SF Awards, Excellence Award.

212521.description:
A growth fantasy where the protagonist, possessed by a character-raising game, turns the weakest Demon King into the strongest!

I had been raising a character in the character-raising simulation game "Evil Queen Maker" with the utmost care, only for the final villain to suddenly make her his bride. When I sent a lengthy complaint about the ending…

“Then go ahead and create a better ending yourself,” and I ended up possessed by the game’s “Evil Queen Maker”! To escape this game, I have to raise the Demon King and see the ending. But the Demon King I have to raise, Seere,” is only 7 years old. The weakest character in the entire world. Caught up in war and intrigue, as Seere grows older, he starts worrying only about how to gain the attention and affection of his teacher, Nahen.

“How do you even raise a kid?”

A parenting fantasy where the protagonist raises Seere to become the strongest Demon King.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: I Became the Teacher of the Weakest Demon Lord
I Became the Master of the Weakest Demon King
I Became the Mentor of the Weakest Demon King

212523.description:
Thirty years have passed since the hero sealed away the Demon King. The world seemed to have regained peace... but under the hero's leadership, the structure of society changed, and humans began to oppress and ruthlessly rule over "dwarves," "elves," and "ogres"—demi-humans. Demi-humans were treated as slaves, their dignity trampled upon day after day. In the midst of all this, the Demon King broke his seal and was resurrected! The epic counterattack of the demi-humans begins now!!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

Note: Originally published as a one-shot under the title "Maou Douji (魔王童子)", was then picked up for serialization.

212526.description:
Moving into her own place was supposed to be a dream come true for Jeong Hye-rang, but her ultra-sensitive neighbor Park Yoon-hee is making it a living nightmare. Every little noise brings another complaint note glued to her door. Determined to check if the walls are truly paper-thin, Hye-rang leans in close to listen—only to catch Yoon-hee in the middle of a very private, very intense moment. Listening to her totally-her-type neighbor masturbate sends a wave of heat straight through her, pushing her to pleasure herself right then and there. Once the thin wall between them isn't enough to keep their desires secret, their petty feud quickly explodes into passion.

(Source: Lezhin US)

212528.description:
Xia Hexuan accidentally lost his sight at the age of 10, but miraculously regained it one day when he turned 19. He always felt as if he had forgotten something important. One day, he was pulled into a game called 'Pandora's Prison,' where the system told him that if he could collect three shards of hope, he could grant one wish. To recover his lost memories, Xia Hexuan began his journey into the game.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

212529.description:
Botan, a middle school student, has been tormented by evil spirits that she started seeing after her pet cat died. Her father has hired various exorcists, but the situation has only gotten worse. As Botan falls deeper into despair, another exorcist hired by her father appears before her, Kokume, a girl the same age as Botan. However, despite being an exorcist, she cannot see spirits…

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

212531.description:
Bae Yu-Ju, who believes that people have a predetermined destiny, meets again—“by fate”—the boy she had once run into by chance at her new school during the summer when she was 18. Will this destiny come true?

A summer coming-of-age school romance about three people.

In the year 3015, humanity has suppressed emotions so that they may advance more efficiently. It is a world that has eliminated unnecessary values, forcing humans to live hollow lives.

Ho-Ban needed Ga-Ae’s money, and Ga-Ae needed Ho-Ban’s power; with their interests aligned, the two begin working together to track down superhuman criminals.

Warrior Ulysses is sent back in time 50 years to save the world, but finds himself entangled with the very person he’s supposed to protect. A decorative heir to the throne x a dutiful warrior from the future

212540.description: Police officer Ahane is exasperated when he is assigned to guard Prince Laronne, a young exiled prince who has no regard for his own safety. However, his frustration turns to horror when he discovers the infatuated prince is more interested in using him as a personal escort!

Jim heads west across the wilderness in search of his missing best friend, Dennis. However, a man named Smith appears before him and claims that Dennis has been taken away by a vampire...?

212542.description:
I’ve always hated Kazama.

We joined the company at the same time and were rivals — I believed I wasn’t inferior to him in any way, but what awaited me at the end of that path was a demotion from my department... In that moment when everything I believed in was shattered, I headed to the company rooftop with a resolve in my heart, but the words that came out of that guy’s mouth were: “Marry me before you jump so I can get the insurance money”.

Filled with rage, I went along with Kazama’s scheme, but as I gradually came to understand his charm, I ended up giving in to the moment and sleeping with him. Now, I, a straight guy, am getting corrupted by that scumbag...

(Source: Daitosha, translated)
212542.hashtag: #俺が逝クまで永遠の愛を誓え

212543.description:
Personality, education, status, money... Everything about him was perfect! Ayako Makuuchi, an up-and-coming office worker in Tokyo, has put her shameful past behind her and now struggles to become one of life's "winners". She's set her sights on Nagata, a senior colleague and her ideal man, and as the distance between them decreases day by day, she seems well on the way to a blissful wedded life... or so she thinks. Enter her childhood friend Eiji, who knows her dark secret and somehow ends up crashing at her place in the city...?!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

212544.description:
I, Haruka Shinozuka, am 27 years old and still a virgin (never had a boyfriend, even). One day, the division chief, Okubo, sees me despairing over being turned down after the confession I had to work up the courage to make. And if that weren't bad enough, he steals my first kiss in the name of "shutting up that pathetic wailing"! Division Chief, who do you think you are? Do you think you can get away with anything just because you're handsome...? But his next words really throw me for a loop: "If you're still single when you turn 28, I'll take you." ...What? Was that just... a proposal?! Division Chief, are you serious?! Before I know it, the two of us are at a hotel, and engaged in some serious premarital relations...

She refuses his advances, saying, "I can't! That old man smell of yours is-...!" A few days later they're reunited, and she's the new intern at his company?! Feeling self-conscious, Jinkawa tries to keep his distance but it seems like the problem isn't that Asami dislikes how he smells... but that it really turns her on.

Letitia, who lost her parents when she was a child, was picked up by a traveling troupe that toured around the country performing music, and was forced to work like a slave. One day, the troupe is invited to perform in a kingdom renowned as the Land of Music, where they receive rave reviews from a music-loving prince. The prince, among others, seems to have developed special feelings for Letitia...

"Can you feel yourself twitching when I touch you down here?"
Mukai and I are bitter rivals always battling to avoid earning the lowest grade in class. I thought I only saw him as a dimwitted pal of mine, but why did my heart start racing when he scored that goal at the alumni soccer game and when he saved me from that girly girl trying to one-up me? Ugh, why does he seem so hot today? After all that, I couldn't ride the last train to get home and he even offered to stay at a karaoke place all night with me... Wait a minute, why are we in this position? He just put it in and I think I'm already going to come...! He's a fool, but I love him! If you're looking for a lighthearted, overly erotic romance between two silly lovebirds, this is definitely one for you!

Come experience what it's like to receive a massage from your lover. Yamato, a new recruit known for his gentle demeanor, discovers the burdens of the women who visit the parlor. A story of healing the women from all walks of life receive from the handsome men at "KIRAMEKI" as their touch softens their hearts, minds and bodies.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

"A wicked boyfriend gets love all twisted up." High school girl, Nonoka and her childhood friend, heir to a large corporation, Kyoichi. Nonoka was used to being treated like a little sister by Kyoichi, her sweet childhood friend. However, this same Kyoichi is infatuated with Nonoka to the point that he'll do anything --- devise ways to keep men away from Nonoka, enact elaborate plans to sleep with Nonoka and even blur the lines of their friendship with the occasional hickie or bite to mark Nonoka as his. One day, Maria is reincarnated as a character in her favorite dating-sim game. As fate would have it, her favorite character and heroine, Lily, appears right before her as well?! Without so much as casting a glance toward her supposed object of desire, the Prince, Maria is overwhelmed by being so near her favorite character, Lilly. But, it turns out Maria's actually reincarnated into the character that bullies Lily in the game...?! Just when Maria thought things would end up with her being hated by her favorite character, she comes to a realization. "Perhaps I can play the role of the villain but still protect Lily from being bullied...?" Resolving to protect Lily's smile at all costs, Maria goes forth with her plan to! But, turns out Prince Al, who is attempting to be with Lily, is onto Maria's tactics?! Let the story of this three-way fantasy entanglement start now!

title.native: 悪役令嬢は推しへの愛が止まらない！～好き放題していたら王子様に見初められました～

212551.description:
"Diana isn't cute!"

Those words from Julius, her first love, traumatized Diana and turned her into a shut-in who stayed at her noble parents' manor out in the countryside.

She became an artisan known as the Witch of Roemer, spending her days making the magic tools she was excellent at creating.

One day, Diana returned to the capital city to attend a ball and ran into Julius again.

As she tried to forget her fleeting feelings of love for him, her overprotective brother created a "Man Repellent Ring" that would drive back any annoying bugs (men) who got near Diana... But it started shocking Julius!

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

212552.description:
I feel like I've known these hot lips and fingers that caress me forever...

Hinako, an office worker in Tokyo, has recently been troubled by strange and lewd dreams. Aoba, an author ten years her senior who raised her after her parents died when she was young, comes to Tokyo for work. Hinako can't hide her joy at being able to live with him for two weeks. But seeing Aoba again after so long makes her heart race as she senses his mature allure. Then, something happens to make Hinako realize her feelings for Aoba, leaving her confused and unsettled. Because of this, their relationship becomes strained...

Meanwhile, Aoba dotes on Hinako while struggling with his role as her guardian. In truth, he wants to keep Hinako hidden from everyone, confine her, hold her close, and shower her with love again and again! His unrestrained desires push him to his limits... But Aoba has a deep reason for his obsession with Hinako. It is a crucial secret concerning his past life...

The frustratingly unrequited love and misunderstanding fantasy between the Water God and his sacrificial bride begins!

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

212553.description:
Only the princess can create the medicine that may save the man she loves.

In an age of swords and conquest- Princess Lillie chooses to study medicine in a monastery before entering a political marriage to protect her kingdom. Meanwhile, in the neighboring kingdom, the king falls in battle and the crown prince vanishes without a trace. One day, a mysterious young man named Wolf appears before Lillie in shackles, carrying a small bottle of medicine. "I want you to make this." The medicine is made from Witch's Crown-a forbidden poisonous herb Lillie has been secretly researching. It becomes evident that Wolf is bound by a terrible curse that destroys his body in exchange for superhuman power.

A fantasy romance between a cursed young man and the princess who may be the only one capable of saving him!

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

One day out of the blue, Takigawa, the guy I am head over heels for, asked me, "What exactly does being 'bad at sex' entail?"!! I could never bring myself to tell him how I feel, so I'm not only flying under his radar, but now he's even asking me stuff like this?! Not knowing what to do, I ended up blurting out, "Would you wanna try it with me...?" What the heck is wrong with me?!?!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Sunhwa lives in a city lined with luxury apartment complexes. Feeling bored as a housewife, she visits 'Hwajung Sauna' on an acquaintance's recommendation, which is said to have excellent facilities and high customer satisfaction nearby. However, the sauna, which she was told was women-only, is packed with men… Dizzying desires unfold within the confined space of a Living in a sprawling city filled with luxury apartment complexes, Seonhwa is a housewife consumed by the dull, repetitive boredom of her daily life. Seeking a fresh escape, she decides to visit "Hwajung Sauna," a high-end local spa highly recommended by an acquaintance for its pristine facilities and rave reviews. However, upon stepping inside what was promised to be an exclusive women-only establishment, Seonhwa is met with a shocking reality: the steam-filled rooms are packed with men. Trapped inside the enclosed, sweltering sanctuary, the boundaries of decency quickly dissolve as intoxicating, forbidden temptations take hold. Surrounded by secret encounters and scandalous desires, Seonhwa finds herself helplessly sinking into the overwhelming heat, unable to pull away:

"This is completely insane... but why does it feel so good...?"

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.native: 気弱な令嬢と追放殿下のイチャイチャ領地経営！～一途で可愛い婚約者を、わたしが一流の領主にしてみせます！～

"Mizui, this spot of yours....is so soft...and sweet..." He's eating me out like a thirsty beast down there, but I've never felt this good before... On Christmas day, I finished work early and excitedly headed to my fiancé's place only to discover that he was cheating on me with my best friend! Utterly devastated by the situation, I went to a river to rid myself of the engagement ring but ended up slipping as a result. Just as I was about to become one with the frigid winter river, Aiba, my colleague came to save the day. One thing led to another and we...

(Source: MangaPlaza)

212561.description:
"Let's keep this between you and I. We'll play til sunrise." With her parents gone, all the support Chiriko had in life came from her older sister. Soon, the two of them will start living together with her sister's husband's family! Chiriko is fully supportive of her sister's happiness, so going out and hooking up anywhere near the house is out of the question. The night before deciding to lead such a peaceful and quiet life, Chiriko runs into a guy who's totally her type. Their chemistry was just right, so they found themselves together getting down all night. The next day, the same guy shows up at the house Chiriko and her sister are moving into. Turns out he's son of Chiriko's sister's husband?!

I sacrificed my precious vacation to attend a pop-up event of a certain modern fantasy I loved so much. And on that very day, I got transported into that fantasy world. As none other than a newly hired employee at a renowned major corporation! A dream workplace with tons of benefits, a high salary, and kind, competent supervisors. Using my knowledge of the world, I quickly climb the corporate ladder!

But am I happy, you ask? Please, let me go back home.

212571.description:
In a fantasy world where mystical powers are harnessed through magical gems known as "Loo," Nino is a total outlier. Despite being a low-ranking member of a bandit crew, he has never been able to manifest a single ability, no matter which gem he touches.

His luck takes an unexpected turn during a routine mission when he stumbles upon a peculiar lamp. But this is no ordinary relic: it is the legendary lamp of Genie, the magical spirit of wishes. Will this chance encounter finally grant Nino the power he's been denied, or lead him into even greater trouble?

212572.description: A collection of after stories to each of the original game's routes.

title.native: 鬼畜眼鏡 全カップリング網羅編＜特別版＞

A special edition anthology for the Animate Girls Festival (AGF) 2012, comprising of extras of Libre manga titles.

Cover Illustration: Shiuko Kano

Suddenly told she was going to inherit all her grandmother's kimonos, Hotori needs to learn kimono dressing in a hurry. But with her intense stranger anxiety, there's no way she can go take a class for it! Just then, a man named Ichigo - who runs a kimono shop - helps her in the street and offers to teach her kimono dressing if she'll work part-time at his shop. At first she declines, but Ichigo's gentlemanly manners put her at ease so finally she takes the job. And no sooner does he say, "Well, let's get you undressed" - could there be a devil's face hiding behind that kindly mask?!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: Undressing You Gently

212577.description:
This is the story of the time I went over to a friend's house. The moment I stepped through the front door, I was buzzing with excitement. Because, for some reason, my friend’s entire family had their faces turned away from me... A special one-shot about a family that refuses to show their faces for some reason!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

A group of boys and girls escape to the rooftop of a school overrun by zombies. What must they do to survive? With death looming and pushed to their limits, what answer will they find? A unique school zombie panic story begins!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

212579.description:
Desert planet Opus-9. Known far and wide as a premier tourist destination, this planet is home to some of the finest hotels in the galaxy. It is in one such hotel that J-ko works as a cleaning robot. But when she enters a guest's room during her rounds one day, she finds something no one could have expected — a guest soaked in blood and barely conscious...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

"Does this feel good, Rei...?" Look, you can't stop leaking..." "We're really doing it... I'm about to have sex with a junior from work..." Rei Ayase is a collected type of girl who people always call "cool". Deep down, she longs to be feminine and fall in love... but before she realized, she was a virgin nearing 30 who was spending her days comforting herself in loneliness. Then one day, the friendliest guy at her office whispered in her ear with a serious gaze. "Could you show me your real self?" With her naughty side exposed, despite it being her first time having sex after dreaming about it for the longest time, she feels incredibly good...!!
