Hajime Ukyo, a handsome lawyer, is a super-elite who has resolved countless messy divorces. However, when it comes to his love life, he's fed up with the many women who flock to him because of his "lawyer" title.

One day, he bumps into Yuzuki Hinata, a flashy girl whom Ukyo dislikes the most, in the street and ends up staining her clothes...!?

"You perverted lawyer gets so worked up over something like this!"

There's no way I could fall for a woman like that! Or so he thought, but the more he talks to her, the more he finds himself drawn to her, as her appearance is completely different from her personality...? When he takes off his elite lawyer mask, he's incredibly cute!

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title.native: 本当は淫乱のくせに～堅物弁護士と拗らせ女子の恋愛裁判～
title.romaji: Hontou wa Inran no Kuse ni: Katabutsu Bengoshi to Kojirase Joshi no Renai Saiban

212582.description:
"Apparently I have a huge cock and incredible stamina. So... I might crush you in my embrace..." My mother keeps nagging me to get married. I finally give in and agree to an arranged marriage meeting. The person who shows up is a very serious-looking man. He has incredible muscles, and he's the president of an infrastructure company. He compliments me, and the atmosphere is good... I thought I'd like to see him again. But, even though he has an amazing body and a solid job, I asked him why he was looking for a partner through an arranged marriage. Then he made a shocking confession!! He said he's so good in bed that women can't keep up and end up getting dumped!? He certainly has incredible muscles... I thought physical compatibility was important before marriage, so I said I wanted to try it out... At that moment, I underestimated his incredible body and stamina...!?

(Source: Shusuisha, translated)

title.native: お見合い相手はXL絶倫筋肉社長 お試しHで気絶寸前の絶頂快感!?
title.romaji: Omiai Aite wa XL Zetsurin Kin'niku Shachou: Otameshi H de Kizetsu Sunzen no Zetchou Kaikan!?

212583.description:
"Will you kiss my feet as proof that this isn't a lie?"

Adela, the second princess of the small eastern kingdom of Renatania, has been ordered to marry Prime Minister Tristan Olio. He is a genius who rose to the position of prime minister at a young age, and a perfect man with excellent swordsmanship skills. However, to Adela, he is also an unpleasant man who only scolds her whenever they meet. ...This marriage is surely a political marriage for her to advance in her career. She thought it wouldn't be a good married life, but on their wedding night, Tristan uttered shocking words!? --I can't believe it. He hates me, so why is he looking at me with such passionate eyes...? [The cool prime minister] x [The ordinary princess who can't be honest] A doting marriage love story that starts from zero affection!?

(Source: Otomitsu, translated)

title.native: 好感度ゼロからはじまる宰相閣下との結婚生活
title.romaji: Koukando Zero kara Hajimaru Saishou Kakka to no Kekkon Seikatsu

212584.description:
"Were you lowering your guard because I was just a brilliant junior colleague?" Never thought I would cross the line with a difficult junior at work...! Yuiko, a company employee, found out that her boyfriend was cheating on her 30th birthday. She books an erotic massage out of self-despair, and the therapist that came was her junior colleague, Akutsu! "Let's feel good and forget him." He clings his tongue while kissing and starts touching her body. "I'm gonna overwrite your body and make sure you remember me." He soothes her inside using his fingers and tongue, so gently that she feels like she's loved. But then he thrusts his thing deep so that she can't escape. Yuiko can't tell what Akutsu's thinking, but she can't help sending him a burning gaze...

(Source: Mobile Media Research)
synonyms: 先輩の身体を「俺」の猛愛で上書きします。

title.english: I'm Gonna Overwrite Your Body with "My" Sex
title.native: 先輩の身体を「俺」とのSEXで上書きします。
title.romaji: Senpai no Karada wo 'Ore' to no SEX de Uwagaki Shimasu.

212585.description:
Ju Yeon-Ho, who works as a tutor at a cram school. An Ji-Hye,a student he met during private lessons four years ago, has returned—completely transformed!?

A nerve-wracking living arrangement that began unexpectedly due to circumstances… Gone are the days of her diligence and intelligence, Ji-Hye has turned into a complete airhead!

Can the immature Ji-Hye grow into a “mature adult”?

(Source: Naver, translated)

212586.description:
A tired middle-aged man gets caught up in a "Saint Summoning" and is reincarnated in another world as "Infant Keita" along with a (bitchy) high school girl! Keita is uneasy about this world that the goddess supposedly created to pass the time, but with magical powers that surpass those of the saint she was given upon reincarnation, wisdom and generosity from his previous life, and above all, his adorable little form, he is cherished by the kind inhabitants of this other world ♡ He enjoys his time in this laid-back other world while being held in the arms of the third prince who acts as his guardian!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title.native: ちったい俺の巻き込まれ異世界生活
title.romaji: Chittai Ore no Makikomare Isekai Seikatsu

212587.description:
Is this lineup for real? Get ready for explosive chemistry in every single episode! A diverse ensemble of characters, each driven by their own wild desires, unique tastes, and untamed secrets, comes together in a relentless stream of cheeky, delightfully wicked, and endlessly entertaining stories. Whether you're looking for dark obsession, laugh-out-loud comedy, intense romance, or guilty-pleasure drama... whatever kind of story you crave, it's guaranteed to be in here.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: The Kink Buffet

212588.description:
Nyorai-kun, a figure potentially serving as the Buddha’s reincarnation, aids a boy reeling from a recent breakup by performing a miracle. Utilizing his unique abilities, Nyorai-kun grants blessings through the removal of worldly desires.

Note: Published in Jump NEXT! 2023 SPRING

title.english: Exposed! With Nyorai
title.native: ひらけ! にょらいくん

212589.description: <i>Note: Published in Weekly Shounen Jump 2026 Issue 26<i>

212590.description:
Melkis, who actually possesses the strongest talent ("Gift"), was banished from the Lordberg family because he did not receive the "Sword Saint" Gift. Various difficulties befall the village he now lords, but Melkis mistakenly believes, "This is a test from my father!"—!?

(Source: Hifumi Shobo, translated)

title.native: 最強ギフトで領地経営スローライフ
title.romaji: Saikyou Gift de Ryouchi Keiei Slow Life

212591.description:
The Continent of Blydell is crawling with mysterious creatures with the ability to physically transform themselves into weapons, suits of armor, and tools, which makes them mankind's best friends. Together, they help fusion beast tamers defend their home and accomplish things beyond their limits. A young tamer and his beast friends take on a great adventure. As he works his way up, he discovers a huge secret!

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: Infinite Level Up With the Mythical Beast

title.english: Transform, Fusion Beasts!
title.native: 我的幻兽可以无限进化
title.romaji: Wo de Huan Shou Keyi Wuxian Jinhua

212593.description: Ye Xi was an ordinary girl, nothing special. She wasn't the worst at anything, but she was never the best either. She was as invisible as air, practically invisible. Until she met Li Zhao… Li Zhao had her own goals; she wanted to become a top fashion designer. From a young age, every step she took was a step closer to her dream. “Clothing can not only change a person's temperament, but also give them boundless confidence,” this saying inspired Ye Xi to embark on her own fashion design journey. She wondered, what kind of transformation could this path bring her? Fortunately, she wasn't alone on this journey. She gained two good friends: the sweet-looking, dramatic Bai Xiaotao and the academically gifted Sun Zhiya. This is the story of a group of girls who met through fashion and are pursuing their dreams, occasionally interspersed with some lighthearted and silly everyday moments!

synonyms: 聖闘士星矢 天界編

title.native: 聖闘士星矢 天界篇

212595.description:
In an era of 10 million single-person households, a story about lovingly tending to one’s own little universe.

Because I am my own caregiver, educator, and guardian. Today, too, Luna feeds, teaches, and protects herself. Single-person living that overcomes rental scams, Single-person economic life as a freelancer, Single-person hobbies that brighten everyday life... Luna’s private universe is filled once again today with tiny, sparkling moments.

A heartfelt song of encouragement from Luna to all those living solo who quietly orbit and protect their own universe.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

212596.description:
Fifteen-year-old Souta Tanaka is the kind of boy who quietly blends into the background, to the point that even his classmates struggle to remember his name. Still, hidden behind his ordinary days is a secret crush on Karen Kozakura, a famous influencer with over 100,000 followers on social media. Souta never thought someone like Karen would ever cross paths with him in any meaningful way. But after a chance encounter brings them together, he ends up listening to her worries about love...

A romantic comedy centered around a background character unfolds in the kindest way imaginable!

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

212597.description:
Kotoka is the only daughter of the Hoshou family, a prestigious family that has only produced female heirs for generations. From a young age she was told that she would take a "mukoyoshi," a centuries-old Japanese tradition of a man being adopted into his wife's family as the heir to continue the family line. Before she knew it, she was already in her mid-twenties, and her mother arranges for Kotoka to meet her potential suitor. But it turns out to be that man from work?! The one her coworkers say is "the last man on earth I'd want to marry"?! Although his attitude and choice of words when they first meet is concerning, she decides to go along with it for a little while, confident that she can turn him down anytime. To her surprise, they get along well and thus their life trying to live together before marriage begins!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: My Boss is My Stallion!
title.native: 上司がムコ入り!? ～極上の種馬になってやるよ
title.romaji: Joushi ga Mukoiri!?: Gokujou no Taneuma ni Natte yaru yo

212598.description:
That flirtatious manner... Those sweet nothings... She's had enough of playing around with men who are more concerned with themselves than a potential partner! But if she's going to have something sweet, she might as well get her fill...!! Eri Hosokawa, a thirtyish office worker in Tokyo, is beautiful and popular with men, but terminally unlucky in finding a lasting love. Nagata, a senior colleague, is reliable and well-liked around the office, but he's the same sort of no-good, full-of-himself perpetual bachelor she swore she wouldn't fall for... and yet, when she sees Nagata lamenting his lack of prospects, even she can't help but feel bad for him. But how did she end up staying at his apartment?!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: My Dirty-Minded Coworker, My Love?!
title.native: ヘンタイさまは先パイさま!?

212599.description:
Mieko works at her dream job as a wedding planner and is about to turn 30. Unfortunately, not all is rainbows and unicorns as she constantly feels pressure from her friends and mother to get hitched herself. When she gets teased at a company dinner for being single when two of the younger girls at the office just got married, she begins downing glass after glass.

Seeing her in her inebriated state, Shuji, her young yet reliable (and not to mention hot) coworker offers to take her home. Once they arrive, Mieko's loneliness reaches its threshold, and with her inhibitions already dulled, she does the unthinkable! Come morning though, when the guilt begins to settle in, Shuji proposes that they move in together once he graduates college! Should she feel joy? Should she worry about their age gap? What's a woman to do?!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: This Younger Man Won't Let Go of Me Until Morning!
title.native: 年下くんが朝まで離してくれませんっ！

212600.description:
When lewd moans, the kind you might hear in a bedroom or a motel, echoed loudly across the court, the men holding tennis rackets cleared their throats and crossed their legs. The source of the moans was Doiji, a pure and innocent beauty with black hair, and the one and only female member of the Magpie Tennis Club.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

212601.description:
After a painful rejection, Lee Cheong-Myeong did everything he could to keep his distance from his handsome next-door neighbor, Kwon Sa-Heon. But plans change when college acceptance lands Cheong-Myeong right back under the same roof as Sa-Heon, forcing them into a sudden living-together dynamic.

Only, the rules of their relationship have changed. The sweet, perfect hyung is no longer keeping his distance. Instead, Sa-Heon begins pulling Cheong-Myeong into a dizzying maze of intense physical boundaries and mixed signals. Caught between lingering heartache and a sudden surge of heat, Cheong-Myeong is left questioning where the line between brotherly care and raw obsession truly lies.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: Sweet, Sugar, Candyman

212602.description:
Nam Yu-Ho, who entered veterinary school out of a deep love for cats and has now become a third-year student, has a recent worry. Not only did a junior named Ryu Si-An, whom he met while caring for a stray cat named Man-Duk, appear in his dreams in the form of a cat, but he also dreamt of having sex with him while he was a cat. Hit by a reality check over this perverted dream that violates professional ethics, Yu-Ho tries to avoid Si-An as much as possible, but…

Wait? Who are you? Why are you showing up in real life dressed as a cat?!

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)
synonyms: น้องเหมียวที่รัก

212603.description:
Ki Yun-Ho, once the sub-vocalist of a top-tier idol group! While living a semi-forced unemployed life after his military discharge, he unexpectedly receives a casting offer for a variety show from a famous PD. But wait, the filming location is the jungle? And to make matters worse, the only guest is his former member and ex-boyfriend, Park Chil-Sung (The Neil)?! Will he be able to finish this show safely...?

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

212604.description: Note: Part of Haewadal Studio's Saegya Danpyeonseon (색야 단편선) Collection.
synonyms: [Saekya Short Story Collection] About My Lover Being xx

212605.description:
Kentaro has been dating his childhood friend Chiemi for 6 years now. As small dissatisfactions slowly pile up between them, the two find themselves going through a rough patch. One day, as thoughts of “What if I were dating someone other than Chiemi...?” begin to spiral, he stumbles upon a service called “Dream Partner” that promises the ideal lover...?

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.english: Dream Partner

212606.description:
Joanna is devastated when her younger sister steals her fiancé. But then, a new engagement proposal arrives: Vincent from the Linehan Marquis family. With her previously useless "login bonus" skill blossoming, and receiving doting affection from the handsome future Marquis Vincent and his family—the unfortunate young lady Joanna finds true happiness in this sweet fantasy!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title.native: 役立たずスキル【ログインボーナス】で捨てられた令嬢が、本当の幸せをつかむまで

212609.description: Note: Part of Metatoon's Gyeryak Danpyeonseon (계략 단편선) Collection.

synonyms: Even a Hopeless Romantic Wants to Be Loved!

212611.description: Note: Originally self-published on the author's Aladin account. Was published by Ridibooks on 2026-05-09.
synonyms: It's My First Time with a Pretty Boy!

212612.description:
Leon Klein, the Grand Mage who defeated the Demon Lord and saved the world, falls into a dark pit after Prince Schalk attacks him and reveals that he’s burned down the orphanage Leon cares deeply about. Trapped in the abyss, Leon spends the next decade slaying endless hordes of monsters, acquiring mysterious spells, fueled by his desire for revenge. Leon finally escapes this hell, only to wake up in the body of Ren Kuroba, a bullied teenager who attends the prestigious Seio Academy. As he adjusts to his new life, Leon soon discovers that Schalk is also here, advancing his sinister plans behind the scenes. Leon may have a new identity, but his quest for vengeance is far from over.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: The Underworld Transcendent Is Unrivaled at the School
เด็กใหม่จากนรก

title.english: The Underworld Transcendent Returns
title.native: 冥界の超越者、アカデミーへ帰還する

212613.description:
Kyoichiro Misato, leader of the strongest adventurer group, Golden Seekers, is betrayed by his comrades and trapped inside a gate. On the brink of death, he uses his powers to be reincarnated as Kyosuke Asai, a student mocked for being Attributeless, with seemingly no power at all. Kyoichiro, however, knows it holds potential beyond even the legendary Time attribute. Now in Kyosuke’s body at the adventurer academy, he begins to develop that potential and vows revenge on those who betrayed him.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: The Hero Starts Over at the Academy
天才英雄轉生成為訓練生
รีสตาร์ตชีวิตที่อะคาเดมี

title.english: The Genius Hero Enrolls Again
title.native: 元天才英雄、アカデミーでやり直す

212614.description:
Youth is a gamble!!!

(Source: Young Jump, translated)

Note: Published in Weekly Young Jump No.11
synonyms: Shiramine Is All In Again Today

title.native: 白峰さんは今日も賭けてる

212615.description:
The first official comic anthology for the hugely popular game "Arknights: Endfield"! A story of the Endministrator and his companions, woven together with charming operators and their slightly unusual daily lives on "Talos II" through newly drawn color illustrations and 10 comics.

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title.native: アークナイツ:エンドフィールド コミックアンソロジー

212616.description:
I object to that false accusation!!

This great revenge story starts with a foolish denouncment...

At his graduation party, the second prince suddenly denounces Irmhild for the crime of threatening her half-sister. He claimed Irmhild had committed crimes such as pushing her half-sister down the stairs, but the only proof he had was a witness claiming the criminal was a girl with blue hair. "Are you sure you want to do this? I, Irmhild Rippencrock, haven't even been at school this year..." She must clear her name of these crimes, so... Are you ready, Your Highness?

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

title.english: "That" Lives in the Palace

212619.description:
VR games have taken the world by storm, but Jin Seojun had to quit after collapsing when his body failed to sync with the system. Fortunately, the company behind a new VR device offers him a second chance: enter a top-streamer tournament with the device on loan, and keep it if he wins. Those around him doubt he'll make it, but they don't know he was once Nameless, the Sword God. With his legendary sword skills and zero streamer instincts, he's about to turn the gaming world upside down!

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: The Sword God's Livestream

212620.description:
"You're my senior, but it seems you want to do some naughty things with me?" Gahhh... I'm fantasizing about Miki again today...! Toko often fantasizes about a certain underclassman in the same seminar, Miki. Miki's cute, kind, light-hearted and always willing to help Toko with whatever she needs. Is it because of her deep infatuation with Miki that Toko ends up thinking naughty thoughts about him all day? One day when Toko was feeling especially guilty for her thoughts, a turn of events leads Miki to touch Toko's bare skin. Wanting more, Toko comes up with an ingenious plan to satisfy her desires.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: Legal Ways to Get Miki to Touch Me
title.native: 後輩三木くんに合法的にさわってもらう方法
title.romaji: Kouhai Miki-kun ni Gouhou Teki ni Sawatte Morau Houhou

212621.description:
"After 5pm, you're my pet!" Housemaid Raika works under ill-tempered/bad mouthed picture book author Mr. Momota. Clothing, food, shelter and a decent work place. That's all Raika thought she would need after losing her parents and having no other family near. Then this happened: Her apartment burns down and she loses even what little she had. Without anywhere else to turn, Raika decides on reaching out to her boss, Momota, for help. Little did she know that in order to stay with him she'd be met with conditions requiring her to be none other than Momota's pet.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: The Riff-Raff and the Airhead

212622.description:
When your house is haunted by demons, who do you call?

The beautiful city of Kyoto has an ancient history but beneath its placid exterior lies a dark and secretive world of supernatural phenomena. When people are terrorized by spirits, demons, ghosts and monsters they seek out Daiun Miki, a real-life priest at Renkyuji Temple. Known throughout Japan as the "Ghost Story Priest," Miki retells the stories of the desperate people he counsels and protects from these otherworldly creatures.

The eleven horrifying true stories in this book include:

Broken Mirrors — A couple believe the mirrors in their home are cursed when they begin to show far more than their reflections
The Monster of Funaoka Mountain — A group of boys spend the night in a "haunted" park only to discover that legends are often more than mere myths
Kokeshi Doll Mother — An orphan girl develops a powerful bond with her precious doll but when her friend comes between them the consequences turn deadly
The Smell of Impending Death — Daiun explains his ability to smell the stench of death on people who are about to die, and how this is more of a curse than a blessing And seven other chilling tales!

Meticulously adapted by manga artist Tatsuya Morino, Tales of The Kyoto Ghost Story Priest is a fascinating look at the ghostly world of Kyoto from the perspective of a real Buddhist priest.

(Source: Tuttle Publishing)

title.english: Tales of the Kyoto Ghost Story Priest: True Horror Stories From Japan

212623.description:
Due to past sexual trauma, Haruka was unable to find new love. Who knew meeting her strong-willed co-worker Yanase at a mixer and while under the influence would lead to an overnight stay at a hotel together?! Haruka was thrilled by his unusual and gentle behavior, but then Yanase told her that she could thank him for taking care of her by having sex with him...? Is that even okay to do here? Hearing Yanase's sweet whispering voice excites her body, which normally has aversions to sex. Why is her body suddenly sensitive and where are the noises of pleasure coming from..!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: How Can I Still Hate Sex?!: A Beast of a Lover and an Unresponsive Body
title.native: それでもエッチは嫌!?～ケダモノ男子と不感症～
title.romaji: Soredemo Ecchi wa Iya!?: Kedamono Danshi to Fukanshou

title.native: 怪談和尚　妖異の声

212625.description: She wakes up at the scene of her affair—only to find her husband’s sword pointed at her. To avoid execution, she demands a divorce, but her cold and ruthless husband unexpectedly refuses. Instead of rejecting her in disgust, he begins to show an unsettling obsession, turning their relationship into something far more complicated and dangerous.
synonyms: My Husband Caught Me Having an Affair
My Husband Caught Me in the Act

title.native: 夫に浮気現場を見られてしまいました
title.romaji: Otto ni Uwaki Genba wo Mirarete Shimaimashita

212626.description:
Inspector General of the Special Division, has been hunting the serial killer Zero for years, and her pursuit has become an obsession. But who could have known that Jiang Tan, the brilliant doctor who is always by Xia Zhi’s side and enjoys her complete trust, is actually Zero’s other face. When her lover turns out to be two-faced, both an angel and a devil stand before her… Genius Doctor: “I need to use bodily fluids to control your mind and calm your hormonal activity. I’ll need to take a deep sample. I’m a doctor—surely the Inspector General won’t think too much of it?” Serial Killer: “The hormones the Inspector General is secreting—is it because I’m making you happy? I’m so glad~”

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

212627.description:
A schoolgirl’s uniform was found late at night in a wooded area. After inspecting the scene, police suspect a violent crime and begin searching for the missing person. The missing girl is Cheon Ji-Yun, a second-year student at Cheongwang Middle School. She disappeared while investigating In Yu-Jin, a senior at her school who went missing four years ago. The detectives recall a famous statement made by In Yu-Jin’s biological father at the time.

“My child was abducted by aliens.”

And so, the case gradually drifts into the realm of fantasy.

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: My Child Was Abducted by Aliens

Her abilities were recognized, and she was secretly tasked with treating the people as a substitute for Princess Roberta. (Source: MagKan, translated)

As a child, Hwa-Rim accidentally unleashed an ancient serpent spirit that has hunted her ever since. Protected by her late grandmother's shamanic legacy, she spends years in hiding until the spirit possesses a classmate to track her down. Now, with an innocent life at stake and nowhere left to run, Hwa-Rim must confront the evil that has haunted her family before she becomes its next vessel.

(Source: WEBTOON))

Note: This series serves as a prequel to the 2024 film Exhuma (파묘).
synonyms: หลุมพรางแห่งศรัทธา

Sweet Birdcage

死のロンド -オオカミと羊-

212693.description:
Lora is a maid who serves Carmilla, a beautiful but moody vampire suffering from a disease. All she wants is to go to the Walpurgis Night festival and find one of the wish-granting philosopher's stones hidden there by the witches. Although Carmilla is firmly against her going, Lora is determined to get to the festival and sneaks out at night. Will she be able to make her precious wish upon a stone before the sun rises?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Originally self-published on the author's Aladin account. Was published by Ridibooks on 2026-05-09.

“You're familiar with this position, aren't you? You were all over me during the day.”

Yeon-Hwa, who developed a deep-seated aversion to others because of her abilities, meets Sin-Hyeok, opens her heart, reflects on herself, regains her self-esteem, and comes to understand true love.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

212695.description: Note: Part of Playtoon's Play Danpyeonseon (플래이 단편선) Collection.

212696.description:
Eun Ji-U, an adopted child of the Tae Young Group, sets out to give everything back to her adoptive mother, Jeon Hye-Ju, who lost everything because of her. To do so, she approaches Kang In-Hyeok, the CEO of Aiter Hotel and a cousin of her ex-boyfriend, who betrayed her and ruined her plan who is also notorious for being a psychopath. Kang In-Hyeok finds himself strangely intrigued by Ji-U’s advances...

(Source: Naver Series, translated)

212697.description: Note: Part of Metatoon's Dobal Danpyeonseon (도발 단편선) Collection.

212698.description:
Devoted yet calculating love, the love of a romantic wanderer, the love of an animal that follows only its instincts, and even platonic love that casts aside all selfishness... A man and a woman, a dog and a monkey, four beings as different as can be. Their unique ways of loving unfold through alternating perspectives: from a human viewpoint and an animal’s.

(Source: Naver Series, translated)

212700.description:
Sa Baek-Min, the guildmaster of the “From” Hunter Guild, has gone missing in a dungeon. Deputy Guildmaster Baek Sin-A enters the dungeon, which is currently in the midst of its breeding season, to find him. There, she encounters an unknown incubus monster named Glitch...

“I'll protect you until we find that hunter. In return, give me your life force.”

To make matters worse, she has to calm the boss’s heat before she can proceed to the next floor? The sizzling tale of B-rank hunter Baek Sin-A and the incubus monster Glitch as they take down the boss♥

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

212701.description: Note: Part of Haewadal Studio's Saegya Danpyeonseon (색야 단편선) Collection.

Notes:

- Includes one extra chapter.

212703.description:
"I told you that you don't have to hold back." The royal prince seemed like a calm person, but he actually has a ferocious hunger and attachment!

The third princess of Alondora, Sasha, was married off almost like a hostage to Eustace, the crown prince of a neighboring country, in place of her half-sister. He was handsome yet cold, and their obligatory wedding night ended in failure due to her fear. After that, their relations were strained. However, Sasha's skill at the piano slowly helped them open up to each other, and one day, he declared that they were going to redo their first night together. "This is where you feel it the most." Sasha was overjoyed by the feeling of being desired and she drowned in his love. However, she then received a letter from her older brother demanding her to get ready to go home!

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

title.english: The Ice Prince Adores the Unfortunate Princess
title.native: 冷たい王弟殿下は薄幸の王女を溺愛する～政略結婚は甘すぎる福音～
title.romaji: Tsumetai ou Otouto Denka wa Hakkou no Oujo wo Dekiai Suru: Seiryaku Kekkon wa Amasugiru Fukuin

212705.description:
One word from the right voice is all it takes to push former star voice actor Lim Sori over the edge. Ever since a past trauma left him with a secret, sound-triggered fetish, Sori has managed his urges in total isolation. That changes on a crowded train when Mi Inha speaks directly into his ear. Devastatingly handsome and deceptively gentle, Inha instantly sees through Sori’s composure. Inha knows who Sori used to be, knows what his voice does to him, and has no intention of letting him walk away.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: Pitch Perfect Love

212706.description:
Live or die. There are no “ifs” here. The story of those who endure the most grueling days in the emergency room, where life and death intersect.

(Source: Naver, translated)

212707.description:
Go Young-Do, a middle-aged man who has spent his life at the bottom of society, ignored by everyone, records a video of himself in a private moment while drunk. When the video is accidentally streamed live, his miserable, overlooked daily life suddenly attracts unexpected attention. What seemed like a form of comfort soon begins to steer Go Young-Do’s life in an unexpected direction.

(Source: Naver, translated)

212708.description:
Driven to the brink of extinction by a colossal tidal wave and the deadly miasma that followed, the remnants of humanity have fled the toxic surface. To survive, they now build their cities atop the colossal bodies of giants.

Left behind in the poisonous depths below, a lower-class boy makes a startling discovery: his master's son looks exactly like him...

(Source: Naver, translated)

212709.description:
"Mean... Did you really think I was some kind of saint?" My admired boss, Tamaki, has a hidden side—he's a cruel tyrant only to me!? Ayakawa Fuyuka, a successful career woman, is generally disliked by those around her for being "competent at work but having a harsh personality"... but in reality, she's quite timid, and her seemingly aloof attitude is just a way of hiding her embarrassment...!

One day, while spending her days feeling self-loathing, she loses her precious keychain, a piece of merchandise of her favorite idol, at the office... When she returns to the office late at night to search for it, her boss from the same department, Tamaki, appears with the keychain! Just when she thinks it's been found, Tamaki says something unexpected... "If you want it back, do as I say." No way... Is Tamaki a split personality!?

(Source: Pinkcherie, translated)

title.native: いじわる上司の環さん 憧れ上司のウラの顔は、私泣かせの飢えた暴君

212710.description:
The kiss includes the intertwining of tongues." A false princess is taught by a cruel and ruthless king to perform a nocturnal...

"I can't hold back my desire to embrace you."

Tiana, a novice nun, is chosen to marry King August of the neighboring kingdom in place of the princess. On the night before her audience, she nearly stumbles, only to be saved by a handsome knight who turns out to be the king himself! In a whirlwind of surprise, they spend their first night together.

"Don't worry. I'll teach you everything," he whispers, his gentle fingers softly awakening parts of Tiana that no one has ever touched. Her body melts with newfound warmth, and her feelings for him deepen with each passing moment.

Even though she's a fake princess, is it really okay to fall in love with King August like this...?

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

title.english: The Fierce King and the Substitute Princess

212711.description:
From rags to quick riches?! Yusaku Kobayashi grew up in a family running an antique store. He started making a lot of money selling some of the antiques online as well! While cleaning the storage room, Koboyashi gets sucked into a cursed mirror he found sitting in the corner. He was sent to another world! Stuck in a new world with nothing but the clothes on his back, he's attacked by a giant golem! However, just in the nick of time, he's rescued by a treasure hunter by the name of Melca. Kobayashi learns from her that this world that's now overrun with monsters has a magical system that sells items in a way similar to online markets! Now he is determined to sell loot from monsters through this online market, and use the money to buy an expensive magic item that could bring him back! Will Kobayashi be able to get back home?! Now starts a fantasy adventure, with riches to be had!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: New World Net Vendor: The Antique Shop Boy Tries to Get Rich Quick Off of Loot!
title.native: 異世界フリマ～骨董屋の息子が捨て素材で一攫千金狙います！～
title.romaji: Isekai Furima: Kotsutouya no Musuko ga Sute Sozai de Ikkaku Senkin Neraimasu!
Kimi no Koe ga Furu Yoru ni

212713.description:
Coming from a poor family and making her debut in high society in a hand-me-down dress, Charlotte encounters a beautiful silver cat in the castle garden. She then immediately strikes up a friendship with the silver-haired Duke Christopher Kirk, who appears as if to replace the cat. The cat is the king's favorite, even being granted a ducal title. Charlotte, believing Christopher is magically transformed into the cat, spends a wonderful, fairytale-like night with him. The next day, a messenger arrives from Christopher, appointing Charlotte to become the cat's attendant…!

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title.english: His Grace, the Cat Duke, Is Dying to Pamper His Caretaker

212714.description:
David wakes up in an alternate reality where men are in short supply and the government is prepared to take extreme measures to solve the birth rate crisis.

(Source: Toomics)

title.english: Where Did All the Men Go?

212715.description:
"It is your duty to make love to your husband."

The bloody king is your first love? The love of the fake princess who grew up in a whorehouse is...

Amelia, whose mother runs a high-class brothel, finds out that she is the daughter of the former king and is to marry Sigrid, the king of a neighboring country, in her cousin's place. She learns that Sigrid, who is known as a king whose hands are soaked in blood, is her first love. But she's unable to reveal the truth to him on their wedding night. "If she knew what she was getting herself into... then she's mine!" Amelia's body melts sweetly under the king's relentless, passionate lovemaking. She can see that he's still the same man she loved back then. But for some reason, Sigrid starts treating her coldly the next morning!

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

212716.description:
Aubrey is a romance following the relationship between a burlesque showgirl named Aubrey and her fan, Arnold. Captivated by her performances, Arnold often watched her with an intense gaze from the foot of the stage. One day, Aubrey suddenly approaches him and asks, "Could we meet tomorrow?"

(Source: Natalie, translated)

212718.description:
When she opens her eyes, she’s suddenly become an idol’s girlfriend?!

‘Haena,’ a college student who just wants to live an ordinary life, finds her everyday world falling apart after being caught up in a false dating rumor with the popular idol ‘Eunha.’

(Source: Naver, translated)

In the year 1890, during the Meiji era, a curious young girl named Kanako is absolutely obsessed with the "Worldwide MIKO SpiriNet," otherwise known as the Internet, which can only be controlled by chosen miko. When she's not browsing message boards, she can be found... capitvated by pictures of men...?!

Yoo Sara wakes up inside a zombie-romance novel, stranded on an island as the hated villainess who shares her face, name, and none of her survival instincts. A corporate slave with no time for romance, she treats the outbreak like a deadline: read the room, manage the panic, reach the portal. But her sudden competence catches the wrong kind of attention, drawing in the male leads and the plot she wants nothing to do with. Too bad Sara’s only goal is to clock out of this nightmare alive!

Dolores, a girl who loves magic, is a 'decaying doll' who feels no pain. She enrolls in a magic school with her familiar cat, Sammy, but is coldly dismissed by a nobleman, Ashley, who tells her she's "nothing more than a corpse being moved by magic..."

Okuda, an Octonoid who came from the sea, is a slightly shy girl with a tendency to mimic her surroundings. Will she be able to get by in this remote rural town? The story of Okuda’s laid-back daily life begins!

(Source: Amazon, translated)

恋は溺れても飲まれるな！

212745.description:
Jian Le, a powerhouse manhua artist, had never missed a day of work. And yet recently, she'd been dragging her feet on deadlines and releasing fewer pages... A deadly artist's block had her in its grip!

Faced with the platform's release pace and metrics demands, her editor, Ren Qinghe, started getting on her case. That included the proposal of a way to appeal to a wider audience... In a fury, Jian Le announced a hiatus. Her good friend Mo Caicai suggested that she take the time to experience life, such as through throwing herself headfirst into a relationship. It was then that a new resident on the floor below her caught her eye. But she couldn't have foreseen what this attraction would lead to...

(Source: Baiheverse)

title.english: Submission Time! Yes or Yes?

212746.description: Nazuna enrolls in the Ninth Boarding School and begins a new life with her three roommates. On the first night, out of curiosity, the three of them go exploring the campus and encounter a terrifying monster... Will Nazuna and her friends be able to graduate from this special school where students are not allowed to go outside for three years?!

"Gonna cum again, how cute." One day, Sayo misses the last train after the celebration for Nagi being the top seller. She rushes to the hotel she booked last minute... Once realizing it, Nagi who had drank the alcohol for her had become extremely drunk......!? Without any other options, they stay at the hotel together! That's when suddenly... "I like you." "I've always wanted to touch you." He wasn't talking but she can hear his voice... What!? To an unknown infatuation, her body becomes hot...

Minami was dumped by her boyfriend because of her excessive libido. To cheer herself up, she went on a day trip with her male friend Soma, but somehow they ended up sharing a room for the night!? She thought he didn't see her as a woman, so nothing could happen. But then, a sleepy Soma hugged her, and she couldn't control her lust... She secretly masturbated when he suddenly pushed her down!? His forceful fingers made lewd squelching sounds, and he made her orgasm multiple times just from foreplay... "Minami, you're a masochist, aren't you?" Soma's hot, hard member was inserted into her wet body. Her male friend's incredible sex was amazing, it was the best...!

title.romaji: Otoko Tomodachi no Zetsurin Sex ga Sugo Sugima Shita: Watashi-tachi wa Seiyoku ga Tsuyosugiru

synonyms: I Became a Munchkin Skill Thief
I Became a Cheat-Level Skill Thief

212750.description:
I, Sakurariel, who lived in the slums, have memories of my past life. Suddenly, an envoy from a duke’s family appeared before me. What do you mean I am the kidnapped daughter of a Duke?! Before I could even wrap my head around it, I was being whisked away to the Duke’s mansion. And that’s when it hit me—this world is the world of "Starlight Symphony", the very otome game I played in my previous life! And of course… I’m the villainess who keeps ending up in total disaster! I have to find a way to avoid my doom!

And my “Gift”, my one and only power given by a god, is "Shop Summoning"? How on earth am I supposed to use this…?
synonyms: Sakura-Colored Strange Girl ~I Thought I Reincarnated as a Slum Orphan, But I’m a Duke’s Daughter and a Villainess. I’ll Survive Using Store Summoning!~

title.romaji: Sakurairo Strange Girl: Tensei Shite Slum-gai no Koji ka to Omottara, Koushaku Reijou de Akuyaku Reijou deshita. Tenpo Shoukan de Ikinobimasu

212751.description:
"You make that expression because you like me, don't you?" A playboy marquis x a crossdressing princess!

"I-I... I'm a man!" She desperately endures the tingling in her body as his tongue slides down her neck. Mary, Trinia's sixth princess, is crazy about plants and minerals and has no interest in making her debut in society or getting married. One day, she disguises herself as a man to hide her identity and attend a salon where she is passionately pursued by the glamorous and handsome young Marquis Franz. Mary's heart pounds as he kisses her for the first time, gently tracing her tongue. Franz is rumored to be a womanizing playboy, but does he actually like men? "May I try something else to see if these feelings are real or not?" As she is paralyzed by his passionate gaze and scent, he unbuttons her chest... What will happen if he finds out she's a woman?

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

title.english: The Playboy Marquis is Determined to Court Me!
title.native: 不埒な侯爵の強引求愛
title.romaji: Furachi na Koushaku no Gouin Kyuuai

212752.description: Note: Originally self-published on Twitter and Pixiv, was then licensed by Ichijinsha for commercial release.

title.native: 亜澄ちゃんと胡蝶ちゃん
ヴァルキリーチューン・ヒューマナイズドアカデミー！

212754.description:
Seolbok is a shameless uniform freak, and the world is her playground. Starting with a steamy encounter on a military base, she sets out on an episodic spree through every profession imaginable. Armed with bold charm and zero shame, she dives headfirst into spicy, episodic adventures to seduce every single man in uniform and see what lies underneath.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: The Uniform Freak
A Succubus Story

212756.description:
“When combined, even trash skills become the ultimate power!!”

Yuichi is an unremarkable convenience store clerk. On the day he finishes a grueling overtime shift that lasted nearly 24 hours, he gets swept up in a magical summoning meant to bring a group of high school delinquents to another world. While the officially summoned students each receive powerful skills from a goddess, Yuichi—who was never supposed to be there—ends up with a massive pile of leftover “trash skills” that were slated for disposal.

To make matters worse, the king who performed the summoning declares him useless and banishes him from the royal palace. However, drawing on the resilience forged through years of harsh work and the practical mindset he’s cultivated over thirty-five years, Yuichi is determined to survive in this new world by “making the most of what he’s got”!!

(Source: Bunkasha, translated)
synonyms: A Middle-Aged Convenience Store Worker Gets Caught Up in a Class Transfer to Another World, and Becomes the Strongest by Mastering the Heroes' Leftover Skills.

title.native: クラス転移に巻き込まれたコンビニ店員のおっさん、勇者には必要なかった余り物スキルを駆使して最強となるようです。　コミック版
title.romaji: Class Teni ni Makikomareta Konbini Tenin no Ossan, Yuusha ni wa Hitsuyou Nakatta Amarimono Skill wo Kushi Shite Saikyou to Naru You desu.: Comic-ban

212757.description:
University student Shiho stumbles into a lolita café, "Melty Lily." There, she befriends Kohaku, one of the boys working there, and is dazzled by the oodles of cute outfits. But something from Shiho's past is holding her back... Can she find love beyond the fairytale? Find out in this bittersweet tale of true love!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.english: Lunolita

212758.description:
"I've been longing to touch your body." A temporary wife is at the mercy of an icy aristocrat.

"No man in his right mind would pass up on a beautiful and innocent woman like you." Arianne, a viscount's daughter who missed her chance to get married, is suddenly proposed to by Duke Fred, also known as the "The Aristocrat of Ice," who says, "I would like to offer you a temporary contractual marriage with the intent to divorce at the end of the contract period." He loves a woman of a different social status, but it seems that he has a reason for needing to marry her immediately. Though hesitant, Arianne accepts the proposal in order to protect her family's livelihood. However, just before the divorce date, Fred loses his memory! Then, as if to deny his previous aloofness, he begins to desire Arianne. Her body cannot resist his sweet, throbbing caresses and responds...
